ui.warn.veiled: This step can be missed by advancing the world or other quests. Switch Guidance Mode to Full Guide to see the details.
ui.untrackable: QuestPath can't detect this step automatically — tick it off yourself.
ui.opt.guidance_mode.help: Minimal: only completed steps and overall progress, no hints. Hints: spoiler-safe direction for your current objective; future steps stay hidden. Full Guide: the complete step-by-step guide, nothing hidden (click any step).
ui.opt.details.help: Show a short recap under each step you have already completed.
ui.opt.group.help: Organize quests by their current region. When a quest advances and its characters relocate, the quest automatically appears under the appropriate region
ui.opt.text_size.help: Scales the text of the quest cards (names, steps, guidance). Buttons, tabs and titles keep their size.
ui.opt.language.help: Language of the overlay and quest text. Translations included in the DLL appear by name. Files placed in the mod's lang folder remain available as a separate '(external)' choice.
ui.opt.sample.name: Sample Quest
ui.opt.sample.step1: A step you have already completed
ui.opt.sample.step1_recap: This short recap of what happened appears under finished steps.
ui.opt.sample.step1_next: In Full Guide you can click a finished step to re-read its directions.
ui.opt.sample.step2_next: Full Guide spells out exactly where to go and what to do.
ui.opt.sample.step2_hint: Hints point you in the right direction without giving the outcome away.

ui.opt.sample.step3: A step further along the quest

q1.name: Irina's Quest
q1.start: Bridge of Sacrifice, on the way into the Weeping Peninsula
q1.s1.title: Irina's Letter
q1.s1.recap: You accepted Irina's letter to deliver to her father Edgar at Castle Morne.
q1.s1.next: Speak to Irina just past the Bridge of Sacrifice, at the entrance to the Weeping Peninsula, and accept her letter for her father.
q1.s1.hint: Irina can be found near the Bridge of Sacrifice, at the entrance to the Weeping Peninsula.
q1.s1.warn: Do not kill Irina yourself, or Hyetta will never appear this playthrough. (If you never take the letter at all, Irina lives - but Edgar stays at Castle Morne and Hyetta never appears either.)
q1.s2.title: Delivering the Letter
q1.s2.recap: You delivered Irina's letter to Edgar at Castle Morne.
q1.s2.next: Deliver Irina's letter to Edgar atop the ramparts of Castle Morne (follow the walkway from the castle plaza).
q1.s2.hint: Irina's letter points toward Castle Morne's ramparts.
q1.s2.warn: You can defeat the Leonine Misbegotten before talking to Edgar without failing the quest - just give him the letter afterward.
q1.s3.title: Irina's Fate
q1.s3.recap: You found Edgar mourning over Irina's body. He swore vengeance against her killers.
q1.s3.next: Defeat the Leonine Misbegotten at the base of Castle Morne, speak with Edgar again on the ramparts, then return to where Irina sat - you will find Edgar mourning over her.
q1.s3.hint: The fighting at Castle Morne is not yet settled. The lower shore and ramparts still deserve attention.
q1.s4.title: Edgar's Vendetta
q1.s4.recap: Edgar, maddened by grief, invaded you as 'Edgar the Revenger' and fell.
q1.s4.next: Travel to the Revenger's Shack on the western shore of Liurnia and defeat the invader 'Edgar the Revenger'. (Killing Edgar anywhere also concludes this.)
q1.s4.hint: A lonely shack on Liurnia's western shore is tied to Edgar's grief.
q2.name: Roderika's Quest
q2.start: Stormhill Shack, just past the Gatefront ruins
q2.s1.title: Meeting Roderika
q2.s1.recap: You met Roderika at the Stormhill Shack. She mentioned her companions being grafted.
q2.s1.next: Meet Roderika at the Stormhill Shack and exhaust her dialogue. She teaches the Sitting Sideways gesture and gives the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.
q2.s1.hint: Roderika shelters at the Stormhill Shack, on the road toward Stormveil.
q2.s2.title: Seeking Purpose
q2.s2.recap: You met Roderika at the Roundtable Hold. She is looking for her purpose.
q2.s2.next: Roderika moves to the Roundtable Hold once you bring her the Chrysalids' Memento (found on the pile of grafted corpses in Stormveil Castle) or reach a site of grace beyond Limgrave and the Weeping Peninsula. Speak with her by the fireplace - she gives a Golden Seed (or leaves it at the shack). The Memento can still be handed over at the Roundtable.
q2.s2.hint: You may want to look for Roderika by the Roundtable Hold's fireplace.
q2.s3.title: An Innate Talent
q2.s3.recap: Hewg mentioned that Roderika has an innate talent for spirit tuning.
q2.s3.next: Speak with Blacksmith Hewg about Roderika. He notes her gift for spirit-tuning.
q2.s3.hint: The Roundtable's blacksmith may see something in Roderika that she cannot.
q2.s4.title: A New Calling
q2.s4.recap: Roderika decided to learn spirit tuning after you told her what Hewg said.
q2.s4.next: Tell Roderika what Hewg said about her talent. She resolves to learn spirit-tuning.
q2.s4.hint: Roderika may want to hear what Hewg thinks of her.
q2.s5.title: Hewg's Reluctance
q2.s5.recap: Hewg was skeptical but agreed to train Roderika.
q2.s5.next: Speak with Hewg again and talk him into taking Roderika as an apprentice.
q2.s5.hint: Hewg may need another word about Roderika.
q2.s6.title: Apprentice Spirit Tuner
q2.s6.recap: Roderika has become an apprentice spirit tuner.
q2.s6.next: Rest at a site of grace. Roderika moves beside Hewg and can strengthen your Spirit Ashes from then on. (Her Crimson Hood can be picked up by the chrysalid pile in Stormveil)
q2.s6.hint: The Roundtable may look a little different after you rest.
q3.name: Sorceress Sellen's Quest
q3.s1.title: Sorceress of the Ruins
q3.s1.recap: You met Sorceress Sellen beneath the Waypoint Ruins.
q3.s1.next: Find Sorceress Sellen beneath the Waypoint Ruins in east Limgrave (defeat the Mad Pumpkin Head guarding her chamber) and speak with her. You can ask to learn sorcery right away - she will sell you her sorceries - but her questline proper only moves once you find Primeval Sorcerer Azur in the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir.
q3.s1.hint: A sorceress studies beneath the Waypoint Ruins, east of Agheel Lake.
q3.s2.title: Finding Lusat
q3.s2.recap: You found Master Lusat sealed in the Sellia Hideaway and told Sellen. She rewarded you with Starlight Shards.
q3.s2.next: Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur in the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir (he grants Comet Azur), then return to Sellen and agree to become her apprentice in pursuit of the primeval current - only now does she truly take you as her student, handing you the Sellian Sealbreaker. Use it in the Sellia Hideaway - its entrance is an illusory wall behind the largest gravestone uphill from the Church of the Plague, northeast of Sellia - receive Stars of Ruin from Lusat, and report back to her.
q3.s2.hint: Sellen's trail points toward a primeval sorcerer secluded in the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir.
q3.s3.title: Sellen's True Body
q3.s3.recap: At the Witchbane Ruins, Sellen's true body entrusted you with her Primal Glintstone.
q3.s3.next: After defeating Starscourge Radahn, speak with Sellen at the Waypoint Ruins: she reveals her true body lies chained beneath the Witchbane Ruins on the Weeping Peninsula. Find it there to receive Sellen's Primal Glintstone.
q3.s3.hint: Radahn's hold on the stars blocks Sellen's path.
q3.s3.warn: Do not strike the chained body - destroying it kills Sellen and ends her questline.
q3.s4.title: Jerren's Warning
q3.s4.recap: Jerren told you his side of Sellen's history - and carried out his old promise.
q3.s4.next: Defeat the boss in Redmane Castle's plaza and exhaust Castellan Jerren's dialogue there. When you next travel elsewhere, the Primal Glintstone trembles: Jerren has carried out his old promise and executed Sellen's imprisoned body.
q3.s4.hint: With the festival quiet, Redmane Castle's castellan still lingers.
q3.s5.title: A New Body
q3.s5.recap: You gave Sellen a new body. She has gone to the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria.
q3.s5.next: Bring the Primal Glintstone to Seluvis's secret cellar: its hidden entrance lies among the small ruins just north of Ranni's Rise at the Three Sisters. Place the glintstone in the puppet body there and speak with the reborn Sellen - she departs for the Academy.
q3.s5.hint: Sellen's trail leads beneath the Three Sisters, among the ruins north of Ranni's Rise.
q3.s6.title: Siding with Jerren
q3.s6.recap: You sided with Jerren and killed Sellen.
q3.s6.next: At the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria, choose Jerren's summon sign and defeat Sellen. Speak with Jerren by the gate afterward.
q3.s6.hint: Two summon signs wait before the Grand Library.
q3.s6.warn: Branch point - the two summon signs before the Grand Library decide who lives. Choosing Jerren ends Sellen's questline here.
q3.s7.title: Siding with Sellen
q3.s7.recap: You sided with Sellen and killed Jerren.
q3.s7.next: At the Grand Library, choose Sellen's summon sign and defeat Witch-Hunter Jerren - he drops the Eccentric Set. Speak with Sellen inside afterward for the Glintstone Kris, and she adds Shard Spiral to her stock.
q3.s7.hint: Two summon signs wait before the Grand Library.
q3.s7.warn: Branch point - choosing Sellen kills Jerren.
q3.s8.title: The School of Mages
q3.s8.recap: Sellen's ambition consumed her: a school of graven mages now sits in the Grand Library.
q3.s8.next: Rest, then return to the Grand Library: Sellen has become a Graven School of sorcerers. The Witch's Glintstone Crown lies beside her, and she still sells her sorceries.
q3.s8.hint: After a rest, the Grand Library is worth another look.
q3.s9.title: Sellen's Glintstone Crown
q3.s9.recap: You claimed the Witch's Glintstone Crown at the Grand Library.
q3.s9.next: However the duel ended, the Witch's Glintstone Crown can be claimed at the Grand Library - looted from Sellen's body if you fought against her, or resting beside the School of Graven Mages if you fought for her.
q3.s9.hint: Whatever became of Sellen, something of hers remains in the Grand Library.
q3.s99.title: Sellen's Death
q3.s99.next: Quest complete. Sellen is dead (if you chose that path).
q4.name: Kenneth Haight's Quest
q4.start: Atop a ruined gate on the road northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts, east Limgrave
q4.s1.title: Fort Haight
q4.s1.recap: Kenneth Haight asked you to reclaim Fort Haight.
q4.s1.next: Hear out Kenneth Haight, shouting from a ruined gate northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts grace, and accept his request to retake Fort Haight (south, beyond the Mistwood).
q4.s1.hint: A noble voice calls from atop a ruin on the road north of the Mistwood.
q4.s2.title: Fort Liberated
q4.s2.recap: You conquered Fort Haight and reported back to Kenneth.
q4.s2.next: Clear Fort Haight - kill the Knight of Godrick commanding it - and report back to Kenneth. He rewards you with the Erdsteel Dagger.
q4.s2.hint: Fort Haight, south beyond the Mistwood, is Kenneth's concern.
q4.s3.title: Swearing Fealty
q4.s3.recap: You pledged your service to Kenneth.
q4.s3.next: Accept Kenneth's offer to enter his service (if you refuse at first, you can still accept later at Fort Haight, where he relocates).
q4.s3.hint: Kenneth has returned to Fort Haight and awaits your answer.
q4.s4.title: The Search for a Lord
q4.s4.recap: You found Kenneth at his ruined fort. He wants to find a proper Lord for Limgrave.
q4.s4.next: After defeating Godrick, speak with Kenneth at Fort Haight. Lacking a rightful lord to serve, he worries over Limgrave's future.
q4.s4.hint: With Stormveil's lord gone, Fort Haight is worth revisiting.
q4.s5.title: A Lord for Limgrave
q4.s5.recap: Kenneth finally found a Lord for Limgrave.
q4.s5.next: See Nepheli Loux's questline to its end (deliver the Stormhawk King ashes to her at the Roundtable Hold), then defeat Morgott, the Omen King, in Leyndell. Rest at Godrick's grace in Stormveil Castle - Kenneth and Nepheli both appear in the throne room. Speak with them there.
q4.s5.hint: Limgrave's future may be settled where Godrick once held court.
q4.s5.warn: Requires Godrick and Morgott both defeated, plus Nepheli's own questline completed - so kill neither Kenneth nor Nepheli.
q4.s99.title: No Lord to be Found
q4.s99.next: Quest complete. Kenneth is dead (if you killed him).
q4.s99.warn: Killing Kenneth drops a Golden Seed but permanently ends his questline (Nepheli's is unaffected).
q5.name: Boc's Quest
q5.start: A small bush beside the Agheel Lake North site of grace — listen for a plea for help
q5.s1.title: Freeing Boc
q5.s1.recap: You freed Boc from the spell that held him as a tree. He gave you mushrooms in thanks.
q5.s1.next: Beside the Agheel Lake North site of grace, a voice calls for help from a small bush by the road - strike it once to free Boc.
q5.s1.hint: The plea near Agheel Lake North comes from somewhere right beside the road.
q5.s2.title: Boc in Trouble
q5.s2.recap: You found Boc beaten by demi-humans near a cave.
q5.s2.next: Meet Boc at the entrance to the Coastal Cave on the beach of west Limgrave. He lies hurt beside the site of grace there.
q5.s2.hint: Boc has returned to a cave on Limgrave's western coast.
q5.s3.title: The Sewing Needle
q5.s3.recap: You gave Boc the Sewing Needle recovered from the cave, and he became your tailor.
q5.s3.next: Defeat the two Demi-Human Chiefs inside the Coastal Cave - they drop the Tailoring Tools and Sewing Needle - then give the Sewing Needle to Boc, and he takes heart and becomes your tailor.
q5.s3.hint: Boc's cave on the western coast still holds what was taken from him.
q5.s4.title: The Golden Sewing Needle
q5.s4.recap: You obtained the Gold Sewing Needle from the Church of Vows.
q5.s4.next: Take the Gold Sewing Needle from a chest at the Church of Vows on the east side of Liurnia, then bring it to Boc at his next stop. Boc moves along your journey - first to the Liurnia Lake-Facing Cliffs - and you must rest at his site of grace for him to appear.
q5.s4.hint: A golden needle waits in a church on the eastern shore of Liurnia's lake.
q5.s5.title: A Gift of Gold
q5.s5.recap: Boc received the Gold Sewing Needle and swore to become a golden seamster.
q5.s5.next: Give Boc the Gold Sewing Needle wherever he now stands. With it he can alter the garments of demigods (sold by Enia at the Roundtable Hold).
q5.s5.hint: Your seamster is waiting for a golden gift.
q5.s6.title: Rebirth Attempt
q5.s6.recap: You answered Boc's doubts about his appearance.
q5.s6.next: Once Boc reaches Leyndell's East Capital Rampart grace and Rennala has been defeated, he asks whether he should be reborn. This is a branch point: give him a Larval Tear to send him to Rennala's chamber to be remade. Or reassure him using the 'You're Beautiful' Prattling Pate beside him.
q5.s6.hint: Boc's doubts deserve care before you answer him.
q5.s6.warn: Rebirth kills Boc. He is reborn as a human and dies when the area next reloads. For an alive ending, use the Prattling Pate 'You're Beautiful' beside him (with this ending, he can be found at the 'East Capital Ramparts' site of grace).
q5.s99.title: Boc's Death
q6.name: Blaidd's Quest
q6.start: Follow the wolf's howl in the Mistwood, east Limgrave
q6.s1.title: Howling in Mistwood
q6.s1.recap: You heard a wolf's howling in Mistwood Ruins.
q6.s1.next: Hear the wolf's howl atop the Mistwood Ruins in eastern Limgrave.
q6.s1.hint: A wolf howls over the Mistwood in eastern Limgrave.
q6.s2.title: The Snap Gesture
q6.s2.recap: Kalé taught you how to snap your fingers.
q6.s2.next: Ask Merchant Kale at the Church of Elleh about the howling. He teaches you the 'Snap' gesture.
q6.s2.hint: Merchant Kale at the Church of Elleh knows something about that howl.
q6.s2.warn: If Kale is dead, the game grants the Snap gesture automatically - the quest continues as normal.
q6.s3.title: Meeting Blaidd
q6.s3.recap: You spoke with Blaidd. He is hunting Darriwil.
q6.s3.next: Use the 'Snap' gesture near the Mistwood Ruins while the howl sounds. Blaidd comes down to speak with you.
q6.s3.hint: The howl in the Mistwood may answer a familiar gesture.
q6.s4.title: The Hunt's End
q6.s4.recap: You slew Darriwil with Blaidd. He commended you to War Counselor Iji in northwest Liurnia.
q6.s4.next: Meet Blaidd at the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in south Limgrave and summon him inside to defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil together. He rewards you and commends you to War Counselor Iji, up the road toward Caria Manor in northwest Liurnia.
q6.s4.hint: Blaidd's quarry has drawn him toward an evergaol in south Limgrave.
q6.s4.warn: Defeating Darriwil before meeting Blaidd does not break the quest - just return to the Evergaol after talking to him.
q6.s5.title: Blaidd's Predicament
q6.s5.recap: You found Blaidd in Siofra. He can't find a way to reach Nokron.
q6.s5.next: After entering Ranni's service, find Blaidd in the Siofra River depths - among the ruins by the spirit spring near the Siofra River Bank grace. He is stumped. Press Seluvis for what he knows, follow his recommendation to Sorceress Sellen, and bring her counsel about the stars back to Blaidd.
q6.s5.hint: Blaidd searches for a way into the eternal city, somewhere beneath the Mistwood's well.
q6.s5.warn: If the Radahn Festival has already begun, Blaidd skips Siofra and waits at Redmane Castle instead - this step is simply passed over.
q6.s6.title: The Radahn Festival
q6.s6.recap: You met Blaidd at Redmane Castle, awaiting the festival of war.
q6.s6.next: Travel to Redmane Castle for the Radahn Festival (it begins once you enter Altus - e.g. via the Grand Lift of Dectus - or approach the castle) and speak with Blaidd among the champions.
q6.s6.hint: A festival gathers champions at Redmane Castle in southern Caelid.
q6.s7.title: The Fallen Star
q6.s7.recap: After Radahn fell, Blaidd pointed you to the star's crater - though duty pulled him elsewhere.
q6.s7.next: Defeat Starscourge Radahn and speak with Blaidd beside the Starscourge Radahn site of grace in the Wailing Dunes. He tells you to meet him where the falling star bit the earth.
q6.s7.hint: After the festival, the battlefield under the fallen star is worth one last look.
q6.s7.warn: Leaving the Wailing Dunes after Radahn's defeat is what sets Blaidd's fate in motion, whether or not you spoke to him here. Say your piece before you go.
q6.s8.title: Iji's Account
q6.s8.recap: Iji told you the stars were unlocked and sent you to the fallen star's crater.
q6.s8.next: Return to War Counselor Iji, up the road toward Caria Manor in northwest Liurnia. He has already heard of Radahn's defeat from Blaidd, and tells you to descend where the fallen star struck Limgrave and claim the treasure of Nokron.
q6.s8.hint: The old blacksmith in northwest Liurnia will have heard the news by now.
q6.s9.title: Blaidd Imprisoned
q6.s9.recap: You found Blaidd locked inside the Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Iji put him there.
q6.s9.next: Blaidd never reaches the crater. Return to the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in south Limgrave, where Darriwil was fought, and stand on the seal to find Blaidd trapped inside. He tells you Iji locked him away, and does not understand why.
q6.s9.hint: The evergaol where the hunt ended holds someone else now.
q6.s9.warn: Nothing in the game points you here. Blaidd stays in the evergaol only until Ranni's questline is carried past the Lake of Rot, and after that this whole leg is gone.
q6.s10.title: Freeing Blaidd
q6.s10.recap: You opened the evergaol and Blaidd set off for Ranni's Rise.
q6.s10.next: Choose to open the evergaol. Blaidd thanks you and leaves to see for himself that Ranni is safe. Speak with him once more before he goes.
q6.s10.hint: The seal that held the hunt's quarry can be opened again.
q6.s11.title: Iji's Reasons
q6.s11.recap: Iji explained why Blaidd had to be caged: a shadow whose Empyrean resists the Two Fingers goes mad.
q6.s11.next: Go back to War Counselor Iji and ask why Blaidd was in the evergaol. He explains that the Two Fingers gave Blaidd to Ranni as a shadow incapable of treachery, and that a shadow whose Empyrean defies the Two Fingers is fated to go mad. He says Blaidd must be neutralised, for Ranni's sake.
q6.s11.hint: Only one person can say why the cage was needed.
q6.s12.title: Blaidd's Madness
q6.s12.recap: Blaidd went mad and now waits hostile outside Ranni's Rise.
q6.s12.next: After Astel, Naturalborn of the Void falls and Ranni departs, return to Ranni's Rise in the Three Sisters. Blaidd waits outside the entrance, no longer himself, and will attack on sight.
q6.s12.hint: When Ranni's road is walked to its end, the wolf is waiting at her tower.
q6.s12.warn: He appears here whether or not you did anything else in his story. If he spots you and you are not ready, retreat into the tower and take the elevator - he resets after a while.
q6.s13.title: The Half-Wolf's End
q6.s13.recap: You put Blaidd down and took the Royal Greatsword and his armor.
q6.s13.next: Defeat Blaidd outside Ranni's Rise. He leaves behind the Royal Greatsword and Blaidd's Armor, Gauntlets and Greaves. The Black Wolf Mask that completes the set is not on his body - it lies near Seluvis's Rise.
q6.s13.hint: There is only one way this ends.
q7.name: Sorcerer Thops' Quest
q7.s1.title: The Glintstone Key
q7.s1.recap: Thops asked you to find a glintstone key to return to the Academy.
q7.s1.next: Speak with Sorcerer Thops at the Church of Irith in southern Liurnia. He asks for a glintstone key so he can return to the Academy. (Your own key, from the corpse guarded by Glintstone Dragon Smarag west of the Academy, cannot be handed over. He needs one of his own.)
q7.s1.hint: A humble sorcerer prays at the Church of Irith, just up the cliff from Stormveil.
q7.s2.title: A Key for Thops
q7.s2.recap: You gave Thops his own Academy Glintstone Key so he could resume his studies.
q7.s2.next: Find the second Academy Glintstone Key inside the Academy: climb to the rooftops from the Debate Parlor courtyard, work your way down across the roofs to the rafters above the Church of the Cuckoo, and drop onto the hanging chandelier that holds the key. Give it to Thops at the Church of Irith.
q7.s2.hint: The Academy's spare key is somewhere high above the Church of the Cuckoo.
q7.s99.title: Thops' Death
q7.s99.recap: Sorcerer Thops is dead, returned at last to his beloved Academy.
q7.s99.next: Thops returned to the Academy. He sits at the Schoolhouse Classroom grace room - found dead over his desk, leaving his bell bearing, the Academy Glintstone Staff, and Thops's Barrier.
q8.name: Patches' Quest
q8.s1.title: Patches' Ambush
q8.s1.recap: You fought Patches at the end of Murkwater Cave and accepted his surrender.
q8.s1.next: Go to the end of Murkwater Cave, past the Highwayman bandits, and open the chest to trigger the fight. Patches surrenders once half his health is gone - stop attacking to accept, and he hands you two Golden Runes and the Grovel for Mercy gesture.
q8.s1.hint: A treasure chest at the end of Murkwater Cave has someone keeping an eye on it.
q8.s1.warn: If you keep hitting him while he is trying to surrender he turns hostile again. Killing him during this fight costs you his shop for the rest of the playthrough, though his Bell Bearing can be handed to the Twin Maiden Husks.
q8.s2.title: Forgive and Forget
q8.s2.recap: You heard Patches out after sparing him. He turned friendly and invited you back.
q8.s2.next: Speak with Patches after accepting his surrender. He asks whether you forgive him - either answer works, he becomes friendly regardless - and invites you to come back later, when his shop opens.
q8.s2.hint: The man you just spared has something to say for himself.
q8.s3.title: The Trapped Chest
q8.s3.recap: You opened Patches' second chest and were teleported away to the Mistwood Ruins.
q8.s3.next: Return to Patches' camp once his shop is open. There is a new chest there you can ask him about - open it, and the trap he set teleports you off to the Mistwood Ruins.
q8.s3.hint: There is a second chest at Patches' camp, and he is very relaxed about you opening it.
q8.s4.title: Calm Down!
q8.s4.recap: You went back to Patches after his chest prank and he taught you the Calm Down gesture.
q8.s4.next: Make your way back to Patches in Murkwater Cave after the chest teleported you away. He gives you the Calm Down gesture.
q8.s4.hint: Patches will want to hear how you enjoyed his little joke.
q8.s5.title: Word of Rya
q8.s5.recap: Patches mentioned a girl named Rya he had spotted on the Liurnia highroad.
q8.s5.next: Once you reach Liurnia, Patches sets up camp at the Scenic Isle site of grace, a raised isle in the southern part of the swamp. Pick his 'Speaking of...' option - he mentions a girl called Rya he saw on the highroad, who he reckons is in need of help. Optional, but it is how you hear about her.
q8.s5.hint: Patches has moved to Liurnia and has some gossip to share.
q8.s6.title: The Iron Maiden Trick
q8.s6.recap: Patches told you the Abductor Virgin beneath the Academy waterwheel would carry you to the Erdtree.
q8.s6.next: Pick Patches' 'Talk' option at Scenic Isle. He recommends letting the Abductor Virgin at the bottom of the great waterwheel in the middle of Raya Lucaria Academy capture you, claiming its transpositional powers will drop you at the base of the Erdtree.
q8.s6.hint: Patches has a travel tip involving the Academy's great waterwheel.
q8.s7.title: Volcano Manor Teleport
q8.s7.recap: Patches' shortcut dumped you in the fiery inquisition chambers of Volcano Manor.
q8.s7.next: Let the Abductor Virgin capture you. Instead of the Erdtree it delivers you to the fiery inquisition chambers of Volcano Manor, and you cannot warp out until you rest at a site of grace. Fighting your way out - past the Abductor Virgin duo - is one of the routes to the Altus Plateau.
q8.s7.hint: The iron maiden under the Academy waterwheel does go somewhere, just not where you were told.
q8.s7.warn: Falling for the trick is optional. The rest of Patches' story plays out the same either way.
q8.s8.title: The Shiny Path
q8.s8.recap: Patches pointed you down a trail of Rainbow Stones on Mt. Gelmir.
q8.s8.next: Once you set foot on the Altus Plateau, Patches moves to Mt. Gelmir, near the cliff west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace. Speak to him - he insists he is doing nothing suspicious at all and directs you towards a trail of Rainbow Stones.
q8.s8.hint: Patches has made camp on Mt. Gelmir, west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite.
q8.s8.warn: His shop stays closed while he is camped here.
q8.s9.title: Patches' Betrayal
q8.s9.recap: Patches kicked you off the Mt. Gelmir cliff.
q8.s9.next: Follow the Rainbow Stones to the edge of the cliff. A cutscene triggers in which Patches kicks you down and tells you to steer clear of Volcano Manor. Go back up to him afterwards - he warns you again, and teaches the Calm Down gesture if you never received it.
q8.s9.hint: The Rainbow Stones on Mt. Gelmir deserve some caution.
q8.s10.title: A New Affiliation
q8.s10.recap: You found Patches trading in Volcano Manor's entrance hall after joining.
q8.s10.next: Join Volcano Manor by accepting Tanith's offer. Patches turns up in the entrance hallway northwest of the site of grace, selling his wares again - speak with him there.
q8.s10.hint: Volcano Manor may have room for an old acquaintance.
q8.s11.title: Patches' Missive
q8.s11.recap: Patches handed you the Letter to Patches, naming Great Horned Tragoth as the target.
q8.s11.next: Complete one of Tanith's assassination requests first, then speak to Patches to receive the Letter to Patches. It designates Great Horned Tragoth as your target.
q8.s11.hint: Once you have carried out a request for the Manor, Patches has one of his own.
q8.s12.title: Great Horned Tragoth
q8.s12.recap: You invaded Great Horned Tragoth's world and killed him, earning the Bull-Goat set.
q8.s12.next: Rest at the grace inside Magma Wyrm Makar's boss room at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook, then use the summon sign there to invade Great Horned Tragoth's world and slay him. He drops the Bull-Goat set.
q8.s12.hint: Patches' mark keeps to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.
q8.s13.title: Mission Reported
q8.s13.recap: You told Patches the contract was done and he said he would report it to Tanith.
q8.s13.next: Go back to Patches at Volcano Manor and pick 'The request is done'. He says he will report the assignment to Tanith.
q8.s13.hint: Patches will want to hear that his errand is finished.
q8.s14.title: The Magma Whip Candlestick
q8.s14.recap: Patches begrudgingly paid you with the Magma Whip Candlestick.
q8.s14.next: Reload the area and talk to Patches once more. He begrudgingly rewards you with the Magma Whip Candlestick.
q8.s14.hint: Patches still owes you for that errand.
q8.s14.warn: Collect it before Patches leaves Volcano Manor - he leaves once you kill the area boss, the God-Devouring Serpent - or it is lost.
q8.s15.title: The Dancer's Castanets
q8.s15.recap: Patches gave you the Dancer's Castanets to deliver to Tanith.
q8.s15.next: After Rykard falls, find Patches lying incapacitated at the Shaded Castle, on the bridge leading to Elemer of the Briar. He hands you the Dancer's Castanets and asks you to give them to Tanith.
q8.s15.hint: Patches has turned up at the Shaded Castle, in front of the boss room.
q8.s15.warn: Do not attack him here. He dies from any hit no matter how weak, drops his belongings and the quest ends, costing you the Patches' Crouch gesture.
q8.s16.title: Patches' Crouch
q8.s16.recap: Patches ambushed you in Murkwater Cave one last time and taught you the Patches' Crouch gesture.
q8.s16.next: Defeat Elemer of the Briar and Patches goes back to Murkwater Cave as a boss one last time. He surrenders almost immediately - wait a few seconds and accept it, and he awards the Patches' Crouch gesture. Reload the area and his shop reopens.
q8.s16.hint: Patches has gone back to where the two of you first met.
q8.s16.warn: If he does not appear, reload the area and make sure he has left the Shaded Castle. If Tanith is already dead, travelling to the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy grace should send him back to Murkwater Cave.
q8.s99.title: Patches' Demise
q9.name: Ranni's Quest
q9.s1.title: Ranni's Service
q9.s1.recap: You spoke with Ranni and accepted to serve her.
q9.s1.next: Reach the Three Sisters by clearing Caria Manor (defeat Royal Knight Loretta), then enter Ranni's Rise and pledge yourself to Ranni the Witch's service.
q9.s1.hint: A witch keeps her tower at the Three Sisters, beyond Caria Manor.
q9.s1.warn: If the Radahn Festival has already begun at Redmane Castle, Ranni will not be at her rise for the next step of her quest, because Blaidd is needed and he will not leave the festival. The festival starts on its own once you activate the Grand Lift of Dectus or any site of grace on the Altus Plateau. Ranni reappears once Starscourge Radahn is defeated. If she instead tells you to begone after mentioning the cursemark on her discarded body, speak to Rogier at the Roundtable Hold first and then return to her.
q9.s2.title: The Treasure of Nokron
q9.s2.recap: Ranni tasked you to retrieve a treasure from Nokron.
q9.s2.next: Hear Ranni's task: retrieve the hidden treasure of Nokron, the Eternal City. She asks you to speak with the three who serve her - Half-Wolf Blaidd, War Counselor Iji and Preceptor Seluvis - who wait below.
q9.s2.hint: Ranni has a task to name at her tower.
q9.s3.title: Ranni's Three Servants
q9.s3.recap: You heard out Blaidd, Iji and Seluvis in Ranni's Rise, and Ranni took to her slumber.
q9.s3.next: Speak with the spectral projections of Blaidd, War Counselor Iji and Preceptor Seluvis that appear inside Ranni's Rise, exhausting each one's dialogue. A fog wall seals the tower and fast travel is disabled until all three have had their say. Then return to Ranni, who warns you she is about to enter a long slumber.
q9.s3.hint: Ranni's three servants appear as projections within her tower, and none may leave until they have spoken.
q9.s4.title: Blaidd in the Siofra River
q9.s4.recap: You found Blaidd in the Siofra River. He suspects Seluvis is holding something back.
q9.s4.next: Take the Siofra River Well in the Mistwood down, then travel east from the Siofra River Bank site of grace to the spirit spring. Blaidd waits nearby. He has found no way into Nokron and suspects Preceptor Seluvis knows more than he lets on.
q9.s4.hint: Blaidd went ahead to search for the eternal city. A well in the Mistwood leads down to him.
q9.s4.warn: Clear the enemies around the spirit spring first - they will chase you and interrupt the conversation. If the Radahn Festival has already begun, Blaidd skips Siofra and waits at Redmane Castle instead, and this leg is simply passed over.
q9.s5.title: Seluvis's Introduction
q9.s5.recap: Seluvis named Sorceress Sellen and gave you his introduction to her.
q9.s5.next: Return to Preceptor Seluvis at Seluvis's Rise, next to Ranni's, and ask him about Nokron. He names Sorceress Sellen as someone who may know the way in, and hands you Seluvis's Introduction to show her.
q9.s5.hint: Blaidd's suspicion points back at the preceptor in the neighbouring tower.
q9.s5.warn: If you have killed Seluvis, Blaidd turns hostile and Ranni's questline halts until you seek Absolution with Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows.
q9.s6.title: Sellen's Counsel
q9.s6.recap: Sellen told you that Radahn holds the stars still.
q9.s6.next: Show Seluvis's Introduction to Sorceress Sellen, hidden beneath the Waypoint Ruins in eastern Limgrave. She explains that Starscourge Radahn has used his power to stop the movement of the stars, and that he must be slain before a way into Nokron will open.
q9.s6.hint: Seluvis's letter points to a sorceress hidden beneath ruins in eastern Limgrave.
q9.s6.warn: Hearing Sellen out can be enough on its own to start the Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle, which changes the castle's layout and can pause other NPCs' questlines.
q9.s7.title: Word Back to Blaidd
q9.s7.recap: You told Blaidd what Sellen said about Radahn and the stars.
q9.s7.next: Return to Blaidd in the Siofra River and tell him what Sellen said about Radahn holding the stars still.
q9.s7.hint: Blaidd is still waiting below for word.
q9.s7.warn: Telling Blaidd about Radahn triggers the Radahn Festival, which alters Redmane Castle's layout and can pause other NPCs' questlines. The festival also begins on its own once you reach the Altus Plateau, so this conversation can be missed without breaking the quest.
q9.s8.title: Defeat Radahn
q9.s8.recap: Defeat General Radahn to move Ranni's destiny forward.
q9.s8.next: Defeat Starscourge Radahn at Redmane Castle's festival. His death sets the stars in motion, and a falling star tears open the way to Nokron.
q9.s8.hint: The stars will not move while the general stands.
q9.s9.title: The Fallen Star
q9.s9.recap: Radahn is defeated, unlocking the path to Nokron.
q9.s9.next: A star has fallen south of the Mistwood, close to the ruins where Blaidd was first met. Great chunks of rock hang suspended in the air above the landing site - climb carefully down through the crater into Nokron, the Eternal City. War Counselor Iji can tell you where the star fell if you return to him first.
q9.s9.hint: A star has fallen on Limgrave. Its crater leads somewhere ancient.
q9.s10.title: The Fingerslayer Blade
q9.s10.recap: You found the Fingerslayer Blade in Nokron.
q9.s10.next: Push through Nokron to the Ancestral Woods site of grace, then jump across the nearby ledge back into the city and descend into the Night's Sacred Ground. The Fingerslayer Blade is in a chest beneath the massive skeleton statue there.
q9.s10.hint: Nokron's sacred ground hides the treasure Ranni seeks.
q9.s11.title: The Carian Inverted Statue
q9.s11.recap: You gave Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade and received the Carian Inverted Statue.
q9.s11.next: Give Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. She grants the Carian Inverted Statue and departs on her own path - but her story is not done.
q9.s11.hint: Ranni's tower is the next place for the treasure.
q9.s11.warn: Giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade turns Preceptor Seluvis into a lifeless puppet, locking out the rest of his questline including the Magic Scorpion Charm. Finish what you want from Seluvis first if you care about his line. It also removes the option to give Ranni the Amber Draught, though that route rewards nothing.
q9.s12.title: The Cursemark of Death
q9.s12.recap: You obtained the Cursemark of Death.
q9.s12.next: Place the Carian Inverted Statue on the pedestal at the entrance to the Carian Study Hall to invert it. Climb through to the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia and take the Cursemark of Death from Ranni's burnt original body. (The Cursemark serves Rogier's and Fia's tales.)
q9.s12.hint: The Carian Study Hall on Liurnia's east shore may reveal the statue's purpose.
q9.s13.title: Ranni's Doll
q9.s13.recap: You found a miniature doll of Ranni.
q9.s13.next: The seal on Renna's Rise is gone once Ranni leaves. Go inside, climb the ladder (a chest at the top holds her Snow Witch Set), and take the waygate at the top of the tower to Ainsel River Main. The Miniature Ranni doll lies nearby.
q9.s13.hint: A new waygate has opened atop Renna's Rise.
q9.s14.title: Ranni's Voice
q9.s14.recap: Ranni spoke through the doll and tasked you to kill the Baleful Shadow.
q9.s14.next: Rest at the Ainsel River Main site of grace and choose 'Talk to miniature Ranni' three times. Ranni answers through the doll and demands you eliminate the Baleful Shadow.
q9.s14.hint: A grace in Ainsel's depths may draw a voice from the doll.
q9.s15.title: The Dark Moon Ring
q9.s15.recap: You found the Dark Moon Ring. Seek an altar bathed in moonlight.
q9.s15.next: The Baleful Shadow waits just beyond the Nokstella Waterfall Basin site of grace. Defeat it and Ranni rewards you with the Discarded Palace Key, which opens the chest beside Rennala in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library holding the Dark Moon Ring.
q9.s15.hint: The path beneath Nokstella leads toward one of Ranni's enemies.
q9.s16.title: The Age of Stars
q9.s16.recap: Become Elden Lord with Ranni to begin the Age of Stars.
q9.s16.next: Cross the Lake of Rot into the Grand Cloister, interact with the stone coffin there and defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void. Its exit opens onto the Moonlight Altar. Enter the Cathedral of Manus Celes, drop through the hole near the site of grace, and place the Dark Moon Ring on Ranni's finger at the end of the tunnel. Afterwards, claim the Dark Moon Greatsword where she stood.
q9.s16.hint: Past the Lake of Rot, the dark moon watches over a hidden cathedral.
q9.s16.warn: Taking the Three Fingers' Frenzied Flame locks out Ranni's ending unless cured with Miquella's Needle. To see the Age of Stars, summon Ranni's blue sign near Marika's remains after the Elden Beast instead of touching the remains. Glintstone Dragon Adula also materialises near the Cathedral of Manus Celes whether or not you fought her at the Three Sisters.
q9.s99.title: Ranni's Anger
q9.s99.recap: You angered Ranni and she disappeared.
q9.s99.next: Ranni is angered and disappears if you attack her or give her Seluvis's draught. Absolution with Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows brings her back.
q10.name: Rya's Quest
q10.start: Pavilion by the Birdseye Telescope, north of the Laskyar Ruins in southern Liurnia
q10.s1.title: The Stolen Necklace
q10.s1.recap: You heard Rya out and agreed to retrieve her stolen necklace.
q10.s1.next: Meet Rya under the pavilion next to the Birdseye Telescope, north of the Laskyar Ruins in southern Liurnia. Exhaust her dialogue and she asks you to retrieve a necklace a ruffian stole from her.
q10.s1.hint: A lady sheltering under a pavilion north of the Laskyar Ruins has lost something dear.
q10.s1.warn: Speak to her here before you set foot in Volcano Manor. If you join the Manor first you lose Blackguard Big Boggart and his whole questline for the rest of the playthrough, along with his Boiled Prawn and Boiled Crab.
q10.s2.title: Volcano Manor Invitation
q10.s2.recap: You returned the necklace and Rya rewarded you with a Volcano Manor Invitation.
q10.s2.next: Head north-west from the pavilion to the Boilprawn Shack and buy Rya's Necklace back from Blackguard Big Boggart for 1,000 runes, then return it to her. She rewards you with a Volcano Manor Invitation.
q10.s2.hint: The thief is holed up in a shack to the north-west, and he is open to an offer.
q10.s2.warn: Killing Boggart for the necklace works, but locks you out of finishing his own questline later.
q10.s3.title: The Road to Altus
q10.s3.recap: Rya told you the two ways up to the Altus Plateau, then left Liurnia.
q10.s3.next: Speak with Rya again after taking the invitation. She explains the two main ways up to the Altus Plateau - the Grand Lift of Dectus, and the old tunnel at the base of the valley near it. She leaves Liurnia once you rest or reload.
q10.s3.hint: Rya has travel advice before she moves on.
q10.s4.title: Rya on the Altus Plateau
q10.s4.recap: You met Rya on the Altus Plateau and she offered to take you to Volcano Manor.
q10.s4.next: Reach the Altus Plateau and find Rya. If you used the Grand Lift of Dectus she waits at the top of the lift, to the left of the stairs leaving the platform. If you came up through the Ruin-Strewn Precipice she waits at the lower part of Lux Ruins, up the stairs from the Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace. Take her hand and she spirits you straight into Volcano Manor.
q10.s4.hint: Rya is waiting wherever your road onto the Altus Plateau came out.
q10.s4.warn: If she is at neither spot, ride the Grand Lift of Dectus to the top again to trigger her spawn. She will not appear at all if you reached Leyndell through Fia's questline instead.
q10.s5.title: A New Recruit
q10.s5.recap: You greeted Rya inside Volcano Manor.
q10.s5.next: Speak with Rya in Volcano Manor's drawing room. She is pleased to see you take up the invitation.
q10.s5.hint: Your recruiter is somewhere inside Volcano Manor.
q10.s6.title: Strange Sounds
q10.s6.recap: Rya confided that she keeps hearing something breathing and slithering beyond the walls.
q10.s6.next: Carry out the Manor's first assassination request, then talk to Rya. She admits she keeps hearing strange sounds beyond the walls, like breathing or slithering scales.
q10.s6.hint: The Manor's first errand loosens Rya's tongue.
q10.s7.title: Rya's True Form
q10.s7.recap: You found Rya in a different room, in her true serpentine form.
q10.s7.next: After the Manor's second assassination request Rya moves to a different room in the Manor, where you find her in her true serpentine form. Speak to her - she is mortified, and grateful you treat her as usual.
q10.s7.hint: Rya is no longer in the drawing room, and there is a reason she moved.
q10.s8.title: The Name Zorayas
q10.s8.recap: Rya trusted you with her true name, Zorayas, and told you Tanith is her mother.
q10.s8.next: Speak with Rya again in her serpent form. She gives you her real name, Zorayas, tells you Lady Tanith is her mother, and asks you to keep both secrets.
q10.s8.hint: Rya has more to say now that her disguise has slipped.
q10.s9.title: The Serpent's Trail
q10.s9.recap: Rya told you a serpent slipped into the room next to hers one night and never came out.
q10.s9.next: After the Manor's second assassination request Rya is back in human form in the same room. She tells you she saw something serpentine enter the room next to hers in the night and never leave, and asks you to look into it.
q10.s9.hint: Something Rya saw at night is eating at her.
q10.s10.title: Volcano Manor's Secrets
q10.s10.recap: You told Rya what lies behind the Manor's walls, and that her mother had deceived her.
q10.s10.next: Go through the illusory wall in the room to the right of hers and press on until you reach the grace in Prison Town Church, opening the doors on the way out - the questline will not advance otherwise. Then return to Rya and tell her what you found.
q10.s10.hint: The room beside Rya's has a wall that is not really a wall.
q10.s11.title: The Serpent's Amnion
q10.s11.recap: You gave Rya the Serpent's Amnion. She wanted to know the truth of her birth.
q10.s11.next: Defeat the Godskin Noble in the Temple of Eiglay to claim the Serpent's Amnion, and give it to Rya. She recognises it, is no longer afraid, and wants to know how she was born. She leaves the Manor once you rest at a grace.
q10.s11.hint: Volcano Manor's depths hold something that belongs to Rya.
q10.s11.warn: Do not kill Rykard before you have spoken to Rya in her room down in the dungeon. She vanishes from the Manor and the quest can no longer be finished.
q10.s12.title: The Tonic of Forgetfulness
q10.s12.recap: Tanith gave you the Tonic of Forgetfulness for the troubled Zorayas.
q10.s12.next: Speak to Lady Tanith and pick the new 'Zorayas' absence' option. She hands you a Tonic of Forgetfulness to give to Zorayas. Optional, but you cannot choose the tonic ending without it.
q10.s12.hint: Rya's mother may have something to say about her daughter's absence.
q10.s12.warn: If you have already completed every assassination contract, Tanith will not offer the tonic until Rykard is dead and you have spoken to her again. Once she leaves the Manor she leaves it on her chair instead.
q10.s13.title: Rya's Request
q10.s13.recap: Zorayas told you how she was born and begged you to kill her.
q10.s13.next: Find Zorayas deep in the Manor's dungeon, in a small room beside a lava pit full of cages and skulls. Take the wooden elevator next to the Temple of Eiglay, get off at the hidden doorway just below the top, head straight through the room, out of the window and across the lava floe - she is in the room directly opposite. If the elevator is not active yet, jump from the balcony on the top floor of the Temple of Eiglay instead. She tells you she was born of a hideous ritual and asks you to kill her.
q10.s13.hint: Zorayas has withdrawn somewhere beyond the Temple of Eiglay.
q10.s14.title: Rya's Oblivion
q10.s14.recap: You gave Zorayas the Tonic of Forgetfulness and she fell asleep at peace.
q10.s14.next: Give Zorayas the Tonic of Forgetfulness. She simply goes to sleep. After Rykard falls and the Manor empties she returns to her original spot in the drawing room - exhaust her dialogue there, then reload the area.
q10.s14.hint: There is more than one way to answer what Zorayas asks of you.
q10.s14.warn: Branch point: kill her, give her the tonic, or refuse both. Each ends her story differently and you only get one.
q10.s15.title: Rya's Champion
q10.s15.recap: You refused to kill Zorayas or hand her the tonic, and she resolved to find her own path.
q10.s15.next: Refuse to kill her and withhold the tonic. Come back after Rykard is dead and she has new words for you - she knew you were too kind and too uncompromising to do it.
q10.s15.hint: There is more than one way to answer what Zorayas asks of you.
q10.s15.warn: Branch point: kill her, give her the tonic, or refuse both. Each ends her story differently and you only get one.
q10.s16.title: Daedicar's Woe
q10.s16.recap: Zorayas was gone, leaving Daedicar's Woe behind.
q10.s16.next: Reload the area once her story is settled. Zorayas is gone, and Daedicar's Woe is waiting where she was - along with Zorayas' Letter, if you left her be rather than giving her the tonic.
q10.s16.hint: Whatever Zorayas decides, she leaves something behind.
q10.s99.title: Rya's Death
q11.name: Gowry's Quest
q11.start: Gowry's Shack, near the Sellia gate in Caelid
q11.s1.title: The Unalloyed Gold Needle
q11.s1.recap: Gowry asked you to help Millicent. He directed you to the swamp.
q11.s1.next: Speak with Gowry in his shack on the road to Sellia's gate. He asks you to fetch the Unalloyed Gold Needle so that Millicent might be saved.
q11.s1.hint: An old sage in a rickety shack outside Sellia asks a kindness.
q11.s2.title: Gowry's Examination
q11.s2.recap: You gave the needle to Gowry. He needs time to examine it.
q11.s2.next: Defeat Commander O'Neil amid the Swamp of Aeonia (he carries the Unalloyed Gold Needle) and bring the needle to Gowry.
q11.s2.hint: The needle Gowry seeks is somewhere in the Swamp of Aeonia.
q11.s3.title: The Repaired Needle
q11.s3.recap: Gowry repaired the needle. Take it to Millicent.
q11.s3.next: Speak with Gowry again, he finished mending the needle (you need to either fast-travel or reload the game for him to finish).
q11.s3.hint: Gowry needs a little more time with the needle before Millicent's trail continues east.
q11.s4.title: Curing Millicent
q11.s4.recap: You gave the needle to Millicent, stopping her scarlet rot.
q11.s4.next: Give Millicent the repaired needle at the Church of the Plague, then rest. The needle stays the scarlet rot and she rises.
q11.s4.hint: The Church of the Plague is where Millicent waits.
q11.s5.title: Gowry's Isolation
q11.s5.recap: You spoke with Gowry after Millicent visited his shack and departed for the Erdtree-Gazing Hill.
q11.s5.next: Visit Gowry's shack: Millicent rests there in his stead, then departs for the Erdtree-Gazing Hill. Speak with her, and with Gowry afterward - his shop now stocks Glintstone Stars, Night Shard and Night Maiden's Mist.
q11.s5.hint: Gowry's shack may not be as empty as it was.
q11.s6.title: Millicent's New Arm
q11.s6.recap: Gowry was pleased to hear about Millicent's new arm.
q11.s6.next: Retrieve the Valkyrie's Prosthesis from the Shaded Castle in northern Altus and give it to Millicent at the Erdtree-Gazing Hill, then share the news of her new arm with Gowry.
q11.s6.hint: Millicent's path leads to Altus, while a golden prosthesis waits in the Shaded Castle.
q11.s7.title: A Desperate Prayer
q11.s7.recap: You bought Pest Threads from Gowry's shop, and he taught you the Desperate Prayer gesture.
q11.s7.next: Buy the Pest Threads talisman from Gowry's shop while he still stocks it, he will teach you the Desperate Prayer gesture.
q11.s7.hint: Gowry's shop has something new since Millicent got her arm - worth a look before you move on.
q11.s8.title: Following Millicent
q11.s8.recap: Gowry commented that Millicent is following her mother's footsteps to the Haligtree.
q11.s8.next: Speak with Gowry as Millicent follows her mother's footsteps toward the Haligtree.
q11.s8.hint: Gowry has thoughts on where Millicent is headed.
q11.s9.title: Gowry's Grief
q11.s9.recap: You found Gowry crying about Millicent's fate.
q11.s9.next: After the confrontation between Millicent and her sisters at the Haligtree, return to Gowry's shack, he weeps over how it ended.
q11.s9.hint: After the Haligtree, Gowry's shack is worth revisiting.
q11.s10.title: Millicent's Disownment
q11.s10.recap: Gowry is despaired about Millicent disowning the 'children of the rot'.
q11.s10.next: Speak with Gowry again, he despairs that Millicent disowned the children of the rot.
q11.s10.hint: Gowry may still have more to say in his grief.
q11.s11.title: Millicent's Death
q11.s11.recap: Gowry's part in Millicent's story ended at his shack. He left behind the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing.
q11.s11.next: Bring Gowry word of Millicent's death. His purpose spent, he can at last be slain without consequence, leaving the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing. If you challenged Millicent instead, you simply find him already dead at the shack with the same to loot.
q11.s11.hint: Gowry's shack is where the last news belongs.
q11.s99.title: Gowry's Death
q11.s99.next: Gowry is dead (if you kill him).
q12.name: D's Quest
q12.start: Stormhill, east of Stormhill Shack (Limgrave), then Roundtable Hold
q12.s1.title: Deathroot's Trail
q12.s1.recap: You showed D a Deathroot and accepted his introduction. He marked the hidden sending gate to Gurranq on your map.
q12.s1.next: D first stands in Stormhill, east of Stormhill Shack, mourning a corpse and warning you away from the village to the east. Kill the Tibia Mariner at Summonwater Village for a Deathroot and show it to him - once the Mariner is dead he moves to the village's southwestern entrance, and if you never met him in Limgrave he turns up at the Roundtable Hold instead. Accept his offer to introduce you to Gurranq and he marks a hidden sending gate on your map.
q12.s1.hint: A hunter in Stormhill warns you away from the village east of him. He may know what to make of a mariner's deathroot.
q12.s2.title: The Bestial Sanctum
q12.s2.recap: You reached the Bestial Sanctum and met Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
q12.s2.next: Take the sending gate hidden among the bushes toward the cliffs behind the Third Church of Marika in eastern Limgrave. It drops you in northern Dragonbarrow, far above Limgrave's level, so pick your way carefully into the Bestial Sanctum and meet Gurranq. Feeding him Deathroot is tracked separately as Gurranq's own quest.
q12.s2.hint: A sending gate hidden in the bushes behind the Third Church of Marika leads to a distant sanctum.
q12.s3.title: Golden Order Comrade
q12.s3.recap: D named you a comrade-in-arms and shared the power of the Golden Order with you.
q12.s3.next: Return to D at the Roundtable Hold and speak with him again. Now that you have met Gurranq he names you comrades-in-arms for the duty you share, rewards you, and opens his shop - he sells the Golden Order incantations Litany of Proper Death and Order's Blade.
q12.s3.hint: D would hear how your errand went.
q12.s4.title: The Weathered Dagger
q12.s4.recap: You gave Fia's Weathered Dagger to D.
q12.s4.next: Accept the Weathered Dagger from Fia at the Roundtable (she asks that it be returned to its rightful owner) and hand it to D.
q12.s4.hint: Fia's dagger seems meant for someone at the Roundtable.
q12.s4.warn: Delivering the dagger seals D's fate. Keep the dagger (or never take it) if you would rather D live - though Fia's own tale then stalls. Fia only offers the dagger during a window in her own story (after the Radahn Festival begins), and the offer is lost once you reach Crumbling Farum Azula.
q12.s5.title: Fia's Betrayal
q12.s5.recap: Fia killed D and left the Roundtable Hold.
q12.s5.next: Rest and return: D lies dead in a newly opened room at the back of the Roundtable Hold, past Hewg, and Fia has left the Hold. Collect the Twinned armor set and D's Bell Bearing beside him.
q12.s5.hint: After a rest, the Roundtable is worth another look.
q12.s6.title: D's Legacy
q12.s6.recap: You gave D's Twinned armor to his twin brother in Nokron.
q12.s6.next: In Nokron, east of the Great Waterfall Basin grace, D's silent twin brother leans on the balcony railing just outside the Valiant Gargoyle arena in the Siofra Aqueduct. Interacting with him earns the Inner Order gesture. Give him the Twinned set unaltered, then reload the area and he can be summoned for the Gargoyle fight.
q12.s6.hint: Somewhere in the eternal city, a silent man leans on a balcony above the aqueduct.
q12.s6.warn: The Twinned set has one of the highest vitality ratings in the game, and handing it over means you cannot get it back until much later in your playthrough. Give it to him only when you are ready to part with it.
q12.s7.title: Vengeance
q12.s7.recap: D's brother killed Fia to avenge him.
q12.s7.next: Take the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from Fia and see her story in the Deeproot Depths through, then reload the area: D's brother stands gloating over her corpse. Exhaust his dialogue and reload once more and he vanishes, leaving the Twinned set and the Inseparable Sword behind.
q12.s7.hint: Fia's deepest dream is tied to the brothers' unfinished story.
q12.s99.title: D's Death
q13.name: Gurranq's Quest
q13.s1.title: First Deathroot
q13.s1.recap: You gave Gurranq your first Deathroot and received the Clawmark Seal and the Beast Eye.
q13.s1.next: Feed Gurranq a Deathroot at the Bestial Sanctum. He rewards the first with the Clawmark Seal and the Beast Eye. Nine Deathroot exist in all, dropped by Tibia Mariners and hidden in catacomb chests across the Lands Between.
q13.s1.hint: The beast clergyman hungers for what death leaves in the soil.
q13.s2.title: Second Deathroot
q13.s2.recap: You gave Gurranq a second Deathroot and learned the Bestial Sling incantation.
q13.s2.next: Bring Gurranq a second Deathroot. He teaches you the Bestial Sling incantation.
q13.s2.hint: One root has not sated him. He asks for more.
q13.s3.title: Third Deathroot
q13.s3.recap: You gave Gurranq a third Deathroot and learned the Bestial Vitality incantation.
q13.s3.next: Bring Gurranq a third Deathroot. He teaches you the Bestial Vitality incantation.
q13.s4.title: Fourth Deathroot
q13.s4.recap: You gave Gurranq a fourth Deathroot and received the Ash of War: Beast's Roar. Something in him had begun to turn.
q13.s4.next: Bring Gurranq a fourth Deathroot. He grants the Ash of War: Beast's Roar - and his hunger starts to get the better of him.
q13.s4.hint: A fourth offering. His restraint is wearing thin.
q13.s4.warn: His dialogue stops advancing after the fourth Deathroot until you walk away or rest at a grace. Feeding several roots at once from here skips the lore dialogue, and every outstanding reward is held back until the rage is over.
q13.s5.title: Gurranq's Rampage
q13.s5.recap: Gurranq's hunger turned to frenzy and he attacked you. You beat him down until he came back to himself.
q13.s5.next: Gurranq attacks in a frenzy. Wear him down until he stops - roughly a tenth of his health is enough - then speak with him again and he accepts Deathroot as before.
q13.s5.hint: The beast's hunger has turned to frenzy, but it may yet be calmed.
q13.s5.warn: Do not fight him to the death. He yields well before his health runs out, and frostbite, poison or scarlet rot bring him round faster than melee damage - two frost pots are usually enough. He stays aggressive until you leave and reload the area.
q13.s6.title: Fifth Deathroot
q13.s6.recap: You gave Gurranq a fifth Deathroot and learned the Beast Claw incantation.
q13.s6.next: With Gurranq calm again, bring him a fifth Deathroot. He teaches you the Beast Claw incantation.
q13.s6.hint: Lucid once more, he will take what you bring him.
q13.s7.title: Sixth Deathroot
q13.s7.recap: You gave Gurranq a sixth Deathroot and learned the Stone of Gurranq incantation.
q13.s7.next: Bring Gurranq a sixth Deathroot. He teaches you the Stone of Gurranq incantation.
q13.s7.hint: His appetite has not left him.
q13.s8.title: Seventh Deathroot
q13.s8.recap: You gave Gurranq a seventh Deathroot and received the Beastclaw Greathammer.
q13.s8.next: Bring Gurranq a seventh Deathroot. He rewards you with the Beastclaw Greathammer.
q13.s9.title: Eighth Deathroot
q13.s9.recap: You gave Gurranq an eighth Deathroot and learned Gurranq's Beast Claw incantation.
q13.s9.next: Bring Gurranq an eighth Deathroot. He teaches you Gurranq's Beast Claw incantation.
q13.s9.hint: One root remains before his hunger is spent.
q13.s10.title: Unending Hunger
q13.s10.recap: With the ninth Deathroot, Gurranq admitted he would never be sated. He gave you an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone and left to hunt alone.
q13.s10.next: Bring Gurranq the ninth and last Deathroot. He confesses his hunger will never end, hands you an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone and departs to hunt alone.
q13.s10.hint: The beast clergyman's hunger is nearly spent.
q13.s99.title: Gurranq Slain
q13.s99.recap: You killed Gurranq at the Bestial Sanctum. He dropped an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and whatever Deathroot you had left has nowhere to go. His tale ends here.
q13.s99.next: Gurranq's story has ended in blood.
q14.name: Diallos' Quest
q14.start: Roundtable Hold, or Academy Gate Town in northern Liurnia
q14.s1.title: Lanya's Fate
q14.s1.recap: Diallos asked you to find his servant Lanya.
q14.s1.next: Speak with Diallos at the Roundtable Hold. He is searching for his servant Lanya and asks you to tell him if you find her. He does not wait forever - simply reaching northern Liurnia sends him off after her whether or not you ever spoke to him - so if he is no longer at the Hold, pick his story up at Academy Gate Town instead.
q14.s1.hint: A knight of House Hoslow paces the Roundtable, worried for his servant.
q14.s2.title: Lanya's Body
q14.s2.recap: You found Lanya's body. Diallos wept over her and asked where to find her killers.
q14.s2.next: Find Diallos in northern Liurnia, north and slightly west of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace - at ground level on the northern edge of the town ruins, about the rightmost tip of the Academy Gate Town icon on your map. Speak with him as he grieves over Lanya. This works as the start of his story too if you never met him at the Roundtable Hold.
q14.s2.hint: Look for him on the sunken rooftops north of the Academy Gate Town grace.
q14.s2.warn: Find Diallos here before you finish the Volcano Manor legacy dungeon. Clear it first and he never appears at the ruins, which ends his story for this playthrough.
q14.s3.title: Volcano Manor Invitation
q14.s3.recap: Back at the Roundtable Hold, Diallos told you the recusants had invited him to join them.
q14.s3.next: Diallos returns to the Roundtable Hold. Speak with him there and exhaust his dialogue: the recusants who took Lanya have invited him to join them, and he has taken them up on it. He names their hideout - the manor on Mt. Gelmir, off the old road leading west from the town of windmills.
q14.s3.hint: Diallos has gone back to the Hold with news of the recusants.
q14.s4.title: Joining Volcano Manor
q14.s4.recap: Diallos joined Volcano Manor, seemingly convinced.
q14.s4.next: Join Volcano Manor and find Diallos in its drawing room - now, to your surprise, a member himself.
q14.s4.hint: The trail of House Hoslow leads to the recusants' manor.
q14.s4.warn: Diallos leaves the Manor for good once you accept its second letter or defeat Rykard. Speak with him between assassination contracts while you still can.
q14.s5.title: Diallos' Foolishness
q14.s5.recap: You drew out Diallos at Volcano Manor. He admitted he was not cut out for bloodshed and lamented his foolishness.
q14.s5.next: Return to Diallos at the Manor as you work through its assassination contracts and exhaust his dialogue, until he drops the talk of champions and admits he is a complete fool.
q14.s5.hint: Diallos is having doubts about the recusant life.
q14.s5.warn: This confession is easy to miss. Diallos only reaches it once you have completed at least one assassination contract and spoken with him again, and he leaves the Manor for good after its second letter or Rykard's death. If he only repeats himself, reload the area and exhaust his dialogue again.
q14.s6.title: The New Potentate
q14.s6.recap: You found Diallos in Jarburg, where he had become the new Potentate.
q14.s6.next: Once Diallos has left the Manor, advance Jar-Bairn's story in Jarburg. Talk to him and rest at the grace until he mentions a new Potentate who has just arrived, then find Diallos in one of the shacks tending a little jar and speak with him.
q14.s6.hint: A humbled knight has found quieter work among the jars.
q14.s6.warn: Let some time pass after you first see him in Jarburg, then speak with him again. Exhausting his and Jar-Bairn's dialogue and resting is what carries the story forward.
q14.s7.title: Diallos' Last Stand
q14.s7.recap: Diallos died a true knight of Hoslow, defending Jarburg from poachers.
q14.s7.next: Progress Alexander's story by exhausting his dialogue in Radahn's arena after Radahn falls, then return to Jarburg. Poachers have raided the village and Diallos lies mortally wounded. Hear him out and answer when he asks whether he defended the jars.
q14.s7.hint: Jarburg's peace is fragile. Its story unfolds across return visits.
q14.s7.warn: Diallos dies either way you answer him. If Radahn and Alexander are done but Jarburg has still not been attacked, rest at the Jarburg grace and pass time until nightfall, or travel to the Starscourge Radahn grace and back.
q14.s8.title: Jar-Bairn's Vigil
q14.s8.recap: Jar-Bairn kept vigil over Diallos' body, honouring the fallen knight.
q14.s8.next: Reload the area after Diallos dies. Jar-Bairn moves over to his body and takes up his legacy, so speak with him there. Hearing him out is the true end of Diallos' story.
q14.s8.warn: Exhaust Jar-Bairn's dialogue and reload the area once more. Diallos' body then disappears, leaving behind Diallos's Mask, Hoslow's Petal Whip and a Numen's Rune.
q14.s99.title: Diallos' Death
q15.name: Seluvis' Quest
q15.s1.title: Seluvis' Potion
q15.s1.recap: You received a potion from Seluvis to give to Nepheli.
q15.s1.next: Speak to Seluvis's spectral projection at Ranni's Rise, then visit him in person at Seluvis's Rise in the Three Sisters. He presses a suspicious potion on you, to be given to Nepheli Loux.
q15.s1.hint: Ranni's preceptor has a discreet errand for you.
q15.s1.warn: Attacking Seluvis makes Ranni's whole household hostile and shuts her questline down until you buy absolution with Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows.
q15.s2.title: Potion: Nepheli
q15.s2.recap: You gave the potion to Nepheli.
q15.s2.next: Give the potion to Nepheli Loux while she despairs in the Roundtable Hold basement (only possible before she receives the Stormhawk King ashes).
q15.s2.hint: Seluvis's potion still needs an answer. Several hands could receive it.
q15.s2.warn: This dooms Nepheli - she ends as a puppet in Seluvis's cellar, and her own questline and the gathering at Stormveil's throne are lost.
q15.s3.title: Potion: Dung Eater
q15.s3.recap: You gave the potion to the Dung Eater.
q15.s3.next: Give the potion to the Dung Eater while he is bound in his Subterranean Shunning-Grounds cell. He becomes one of Seluvis's puppets.
q15.s3.hint: Seluvis's potion still needs an answer. Several hands could receive it.
q15.s3.warn: This ends the Dung Eater's own questline, so no Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
q15.s4.title: Potion: Gideon
q15.s4.recap: You gave the potion to Gideon. He disposed of it.
q15.s4.next: Hand the potion to Sir Gideon Ofnir at the Roundtable Hold - he quietly disposes of it and says Seluvis will be none the wiser. This is the harmless choice.
q15.s4.hint: Seluvis's potion still needs an answer. Several hands could receive it.
q15.s5.title: Reporting to Seluvis
q15.s5.recap: You reported back to Seluvis that you followed his orders.
q15.s5.next: Report back to Seluvis. He names you his accomplice and opens his sorcery shop to you.
q15.s5.hint: Seluvis will want to know how his errand ended.
q15.s6.title: The Secret Cellar
q15.s6.recap: You found Seluvis' secret cellar, confronted him, and chose a free puppet.
q15.s6.next: Find the hidden ruins north-east of Ranni's Rise, drop through the illusory floor and read the message by the puppets below. Confront Seluvis about them and he offers you one puppet spirit ash of your choice, for free.
q15.s6.hint: The preceptor keeps his 'collection' somewhere beneath the Three Sisters.
q15.s7.title: Seluvis' Collection
q15.s7.recap: You bought more of Seluvis' puppets and drew him out.
q15.s7.next: Buy more puppets from Seluvis with Starlight Shards - Finger Maiden Therolina (2) and Jarwight (3) are always on offer, and a third (5) appears if you had the potion drunk. Rest at a grace and return between visits, exhausting his new dialogue each time, until he starts to confide in you.
q15.s7.hint: Keep coming back to the preceptor. He has more to say than he lets on.
q15.s8.title: Seluvis' Scheme
q15.s8.recap: You agreed to help Seluvis with his scheme.
q15.s8.next: Ask Seluvis about his plan and agree to help. He wants a shard of Amber Starlight for a draught meant to fool Ranni herself.
q15.s8.hint: The preceptor is plotting something, and he needs a hand with it.
q15.s8.warn: Seluvis's scheme must be finished before Ranni receives the Fingerslayer Blade. Once her arc moves on he is beyond helping.
q15.s9.title: Amber Starlight
q15.s9.recap: You fetched the Amber Starlight and handed it to Seluvis.
q15.s9.next: Directly east of the Altus Highway Junction grace the road breaks off north into an open cave. The Amber Starlight sits inside below a statue, surrounded by Land Octopuses. Take it back to Seluvis at his rise and hand it over.
q15.s9.hint: An amber shard of starlight is waiting somewhere on the Altus Plateau.
q15.s10.title: The Magic Scorpion Charm
q15.s10.recap: Seluvis rewarded you with the Magic Scorpion Charm and set to work.
q15.s10.next: Hear Seluvis out after the hand-over. He rewards you with the Magic Scorpion Charm and asks for time to brew.
q15.s10.hint: The preceptor is grateful for what you brought him.
q15.s11.title: The Amber Draught
q15.s11.recap: Seluvis gave you the Amber Draught to administer to Ranni.
q15.s11.next: Rest at a grace or leave the area and come back, then speak with Seluvis again and take the Amber Draught, which he would have Ranni drink.
q15.s11.hint: Give the preceptor time alone with his brewing, then return.
q15.s11.warn: Complete this before handing Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade, or Seluvis's story ends unfinished.
q15.s12.title: Ranni's Disapproval
q15.s12.recap: Ranni discovered Seluvis' plan and cast you away.
q15.s12.next: Offer the draught to Ranni. She sees through the scheme at once and orders you out - carrying the potion does not lock you into betraying Ranni, so you can leave it undrunk and continue her questline instead.
q15.s12.hint: The draught in your pack is meant for Ranni, but she is no fool.
q15.s12.warn: Press Ranni about the draught twice more and she kills you on the spot, and everyone tied to her disappears. Absolution at the Church of Vows with Celestial Dew undoes it, and Seluvis will be found dead in his tower.
q15.s99.title: Seluvis' End
q15.s99.warn: Giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade kills Seluvis and locks out everything he had left to offer. He is found kneeling dead at his rise with the Preceptor's Set and Seluvis's Bell Bearing. Pidia dies to his own puppets at the same time, leaving Pidia's Bell Bearing and a puppet - Nepheli Loux's if she drank the potion, Dolores the Sleeping Arrow's otherwise.
q16.name: Dung Eater's Quest
q16.start: Roundtable Hold, the locked room past the Twin Maiden Husks
q16.s1.title: Meeting the Dung Eater
q16.s1.recap: You met the Dung Eater's spirit at the Roundtable Hold. He had no use for you.
q16.s1.next: Speak with the Dung Eater in the locked room past the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold - the room only opens once you have reached the Altus Plateau. He dismisses you as a stranger to defilement until you are carrying a Seedbed Curse.
q16.s1.hint: A baleful spirit haunts the chamber beyond the Twin Maiden Husks. It only respects a certain kind of curse.
q16.s2.title: Imprisoned Body
q16.s2.recap: You showed the Dung Eater a Seedbed Curse and he gave you the Sewer-Gaol Key.
q16.s2.next: Approach him again carrying at least one Seedbed Curse. He hands over the Sewer-Gaol Key and demands you unshackle his corporeal flesh in the sewer-gaol beneath Leyndell.
q16.s2.hint: A Seedbed Curse in your pack will change how the spirit greets you.
q16.s3.title: Freedom
q16.s3.recap: You unlocked the Dung Eater's cell and told him to leave his gaol.
q16.s3.next: From the Underground Roadside grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, head out of the room, turn left, follow the corridor and drop through the gap in the sewer grate. Go to the end of the tunnel, past the Giant Miranda Sprouts, climb the ladder and unlock the door opposite with the Sewer-Gaol Key. Talk to him and pick 'Leave your gaol!' to release him.
q16.s3.hint: His flesh is locked away in the gaols beneath Leyndell's sewers.
q16.s3.warn: Releasing him unlocks his summon sign for Mohg, the Omen - but that sign disappears again as soon as you advance his questline any further, or kill him.
q16.s4.title: The Outer Moat Duel
q16.s4.recap: You beat the Dung Eater in his invasion at Leyndell's outer moat and took the Sword of Milos.
q16.s4.next: Go back to the Roundtable Hold and read the message he left, then travel to the outer moat in the northern section of Leyndell near the Capital Rampart. Exhaust Blackguard Big Boggart's dialogue there, then walk into the middle of the moat - the Dung Eater invades in the flesh. Beat him and he drops the Sword of Milos.
q16.s4.hint: The Dung Eater left word at the Roundtable about where he wants to settle this.
q16.s4.warn: Finish Blackguard Big Boggart's questline before you trigger this invasion. Winning it first strands him at the moat for good - he never becomes wounded, never dies, and the Seedbed Curse his body would have carried is lost, leaving you to find the other five elsewhere.
q16.s5.title: Defilement
q16.s5.recap: The Dung Eater asked you to defile his body with Seedbed Curses.
q16.s5.next: Return to the Dung Eater at the Roundtable Hold. Beaten, he now understands you and asks you to bring Seedbed Curses to his real body - which is tied to a chair back in the cell you released him from.
q16.s5.hint: The spirit is back at the Roundtable, with a new demand.
q16.s5.warn: His summon sign for Mohg disappears at this point.
q16.s6.title: Seedbed Curses
q16.s6.recap: You defiled the Dung Eater's body with the fifth and final Seedbed Curse.
q16.s6.next: Bring Seedbed Curses to his body in the sewer-gaol cell - five in all. Six exist: three in Leyndell Royal Capital (one of them on Blackguard Big Boggart's body at the end of his questline), one in Volcano Manor and two in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Boggart's is the one you can lose, so the other five are enough on their own.
q16.s6.hint: Seedbed Curses are the only thing his flesh wants now.
q16.s6.warn: Giving him Seluvis's Potion instead of the curses ends his tale on the spot: you get the Dung Eater Puppet from Seluvis, but never the Blessing of Despair ending.
q16.s7.title: The Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
q16.s7.recap: The Dung Eater's tale ended, and the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse was yours.
q16.s7.next: The final curse kills him and leaves you the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse. Reload the area to find the Omen set where he gave you the rune.
q16.s7.hint: The last curse settles what the Dung Eater has been asking for all along.
q16.s99.title: Dung Eater's Demise
q16.s99.recap: The Dung Eater was killed before his work was done.
q16.s99.next: Quest ended. The Dung Eater is dead.
q17.name: Rogier's Quest
q17.start: Chapel near the Grafted Scion, Stormveil Castle
q17.s1.title: Rogier in Stormveil
q17.s1.recap: You met Rogier in Stormveil Castle, searching for something.
q17.s1.next: Meet Rogier in Stormveil Castle's chapel, above the cellar where the Grafted Scion prowls.
q17.s1.hint: A sorcerer-swordsman studies the chapel where the Grafted Scion prowls.
q17.s2.title: Rogier's Injury
q17.s2.recap: You found Rogier at the Roundtable Hold. He can no longer fight.
q17.s2.next: Find Rogier at the Roundtable Hold, resting on the balcony above the hall. His legs are ruined and he can no longer fight.
q17.s2.hint: Rogier has retired to a Roundtable balcony.
q17.s3.title: The Corpse Under Stormveil
q17.s3.recap: You asked Rogier about the corpse you discovered under Stormveil.
q17.s3.next: Discover what lies beneath Stormveil: from the castle's underbelly (down the wooden scaffolding below the Liftside area), reach the cavern holding a giant, deathroot-riddled face. Then ask Rogier about the corpse.
q17.s3.hint: Something vast and dead lies beneath Stormveil. Rogier may know more.
q17.s4.title: The Knifeprint Clue
q17.s4.recap: Fia gave you a clue pointing to the Black Knifeprint's location.
q17.s4.next: Speak with Fia at the Roundtable (let her hold you and exhaust her dialogue). She gives you a Knifeprint Clue, revealing the Black Knife Catacombs in the North East of Liurnia. There, behind an illusory wall in the room before the flooded lever pit, defeat the Black Knife Assassin and take the Black Knifeprint itself.
q17.s4.hint: Fia's knowledge of black knives points toward catacombs in northeastern Liurnia.
q17.s5.title: Lending the Knifeprint
q17.s5.recap: You lent the Black Knifeprint to Rogier for examination.
q17.s5.next: Lend the Black Knifeprint to Rogier for examination.
q17.s5.hint: Rogier would dearly like to examine that knifeprint.
q17.s6.title: Ranni's Involvement
q17.s6.recap: Rogier discovered the culprit and asked you to recover the Cursemark of Death.
q17.s6.next: Return to Rogier (rest first). His study of the knifeprint points to Ranni the Witch, and he asks you to seek the Cursemark of Death.
q17.s6.hint: Rogier's research points toward a suspect.
q17.s7.title: Ranni's Refusal
q17.s7.recap: You met Ranni but couldn't find the Cursemark. It rests on her previous body.
q17.s7.next: Travel to Ranni's Rise beyond Caria Manor (northwest Liurnia) and put the matter to Ranni. She rebuffs you - the cursemark rests with her discarded flesh, not with her.
q17.s7.hint: The suspect keeps a tower at the Three Sisters, beyond Caria Manor.
q17.s8.title: Serving Ranni
q17.s8.recap: Rogier asked you to enter Ranni's service to seek the Cursemark.
q17.s8.next: Return to Rogier. Undeterred, he counsels you to enter Ranni's service and seek the truth from within.
q17.s8.hint: Rogier should hear how the witch received you.
q17.s9.title: Ranni's Service Accepted
q17.s9.recap: As Rogier requested, you entered Ranni's service.
q17.s9.next: Enter Ranni's service at Ranni's Rise (this advances both Rogier's and Ranni's tales).
q17.s9.hint: Rogier's counsel points back to the witch's service.
q17.s10.title: Rogier's Slumber
q17.s10.recap: Rogier feels he's going to fall into slumber.
q17.s10.next: Speak with Rogier as a strange slumber overtakes him. His death is scripted as the tales of Fia and Ranni advance - when he passes, his Spellblade set and a letter rest on his chair.
q17.s10.hint: Rogier grows weary at the Roundtable.
q17.s10.warn: Progressing Fia's and Ranni's stories deepens Rogier's slumber. Exhaust his dialogue while he still wakes. His death (below) is a REQUIRED story beat, not a failure state -- QuestPath will show this quest as "Ended" rather than "Completed" once he dies, the same way it does for every other NPC whose tale concludes in a scripted death.
q17.s99.title: Rogier's Death
q17.s99.next: Rogier dies. You can get his gear.
q18.name: Nepheli's Quest
q18.start: Before the Grafted Scion lift, Stormveil Castle
q18.s1.title: Meeting Nepheli
q18.s1.recap: You met Nepheli in Stormveil Castle. She offered to help defeat Godrick.
q18.s1.next: Meet Nepheli Loux in Stormveil Castle, in the chamber beside the Grafted Scion's courtyard near the Liftside Chamber grace. Her gold summon sign can aid you against Godrick.
q18.s1.hint: A warrior ponders in a chamber near the Liftside grace of Stormveil.
q18.s2.title: A Word with Gideon
q18.s2.recap: You met Nepheli at the Roundtable Hold and spoke about her to Gideon.
q18.s2.next: Speak with Nepheli at the Roundtable Hold, then with Sir Gideon Ofnir about her.
q18.s2.hint: Nepheli and Gideon are both worth seeking at the Roundtable.
q18.s3.title: The Albinauric Village
q18.s3.recap: You found Nepheli pondering at the Village of the Albinaurics.
q18.s3.next: Find Nepheli at the Village of the Albinaurics in Liurnia, standing amid the aftermath of the massacre. Hear her out.
q18.s3.hint: Nepheli broods over a massacre in a village of silver folk.
q18.s4.title: Nepheli's Distress
q18.s4.recap: You found Nepheli in the Roundtable basement, thinking alone.
q18.s4.next: Find Nepheli despairing in the Roundtable Hold basement (down the stairs by the blacksmith).
q18.s4.hint: Nepheli has retreated somewhere below the Roundtable.
q18.s5.title: Gideon's Ambition
q18.s5.recap: You discussed Nepheli's situation with Gideon.
q18.s5.next: Discuss Nepheli with Gideon. He has cast her aside as unworthy of his pursuit.
q18.s5.hint: Her father has opinions about failed apprentices.
q18.s6.title: Cast Out
q18.s6.recap: Nepheli told you she was cast out by Gideon.
q18.s6.next: Speak with Nepheli in the basement about being disowned by Gideon.
q18.s6.hint: Someone should check on the cast-out warrior.
