q18.s7.title: The Stormhawk King
q18.s7.recap: You gave the Stormhawk King ashes to Nepheli.
q18.s7.next: Retrieve the Stormhawk King ashes from the Chapel of Anticipation - return there via the waygate atop the Four Belfries in west Liurnia (an Imbued Sword Key opens it). The ashes lie on the chapel's upper floor. Give them to Nepheli in the basement.
q18.s7.hint: An old king's ashes wait where your journey began.
q18.s7.warn: Giving her the ashes protects her from Seluvis's potion. If you mean to use the potion on her (dooming her), it must come first.
q18.s8.title: Lady of Limgrave
q18.s8.recap: Nepheli became Lady of Limgrave, with Kenneth's help.
q18.s8.next: After defeating Morgott, the Omen King, rest, then return to Stormveil's throne room: Nepheli stands as Lady of Limgrave with Kenneth Haight at her side. Speak with her to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
q18.s8.hint: Limgrave's future waits where Godrick once held court.
q18.s8.warn: Requires Godrick and Morgott both defeated, Kenneth's steps done, and Nepheli untouched by Seluvis's potion.
q18.s99.title: Nepheli's Death
q19.name: Hyetta's Quest
q19.start: Beside the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace, southern Liurnia (after Irina's story ends)
q19.s1.title: A Blind Maiden's Request
q19.s1.recap: You met Hyetta beside the Lake-Facing Cliffs. She asked you for a Shabriri Grape.
q19.s1.next: Meet Hyetta beside the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace in southern Liurnia. She only appears once Irina's story has ended - take Irina's letter to her father Edgar at Castle Morne.
q19.s1.hint: A blind traveller rests by the Lake-Facing Cliffs, asking for a strange grape.
q19.s1.warn: Hyetta never appears at all if you kill Irina yourself.
q19.s2.title: The First Shabriri Grape
q19.s2.recap: You gave Hyetta her first Shabriri Grape and received the As You Wish gesture.
q19.s2.next: Give Hyetta a Shabriri Grape. One lies in Stormveil Castle, on the lower level by Godrick's throne room - reachable by the broken-bridge route without beating Godrick. She rewards you with the As You Wish gesture.
q19.s2.hint: The grape she wants can be found in the castle above the lake.
q19.s3.title: The Purified Ruins
q19.s3.recap: You gave Hyetta a second Shabriri Grape at the Purified Ruins.
q19.s3.next: Follow Hyetta to the Purified Ruins and give her a second Shabriri Grape. That one sits on the ruins' lower level, behind wooden planks you must break.
q19.s3.hint: She has moved on to a ruin further along the lake shore.
q19.s4.title: The Gate Town Bridge
q19.s4.recap: You gave Hyetta a third Shabriri Grape at the Gate Town Bridge.
q19.s4.next: Find Hyetta north of the Gate Town Bridge and give her a third Shabriri Grape. Edgar the Revenger drops one when you defeat him as an invader at the Revenger's Shack. If you killed him back at Castle Morne it lies there instead.
q19.s4.hint: Her road has taken her to a bridge in eastern Liurnia.
q19.s5.title: The Truth of the Grapes
q19.s5.recap: You told Hyetta what the grapes really are.
q19.s5.next: Hyetta asks what the grapes are. Tell her the truth. She is shocked, but the answer is what moves her story on. If you refuse, you can give it on a later visit.
q19.s5.hint: She has a question, and only an honest answer will move her on.
q19.s6.title: Hyetta's Resolve
q19.s6.recap: Hyetta accepted the truth and set off again.
q19.s6.next: Reload the area and speak with Hyetta again at the Gate Town Bridge, exhausting her dialogue. Having accepted the truth she becomes determined and moves on.
q19.s6.hint: Rest, return, and hear her out before she leaves.
q19.s7.title: Bellum Church
q19.s7.recap: You found Hyetta at Bellum Church. She asked for a Fingerprint Grape.
q19.s7.next: Find Hyetta at Bellum Church in north-eastern Liurnia. This time she asks for a Fingerprint Grape.
q19.s7.hint: She waits at a church on the Bellum Highway.
q19.s8.title: The Fingerprint Grape
q19.s8.recap: You defeated Festering Fingerprint Vyke and took the Fingerprint Grape.
q19.s8.next: Defeat the invader Festering Fingerprint Vyke at the Church of Inhibition, on the heights of north-eastern Liurnia. He drops the Fingerprint Grape.
q19.s8.hint: A knight of the fingerprint guards what she needs, near a church on Liurnia's northern heights.
q19.s9.title: Giving the Fingerprint Grape
q19.s9.recap: You gave the Fingerprint Grape to Hyetta.
q19.s9.next: Give the Fingerprint Grape to Hyetta at Bellum Church. She thanks you and departs - she would become a finger maiden.
q19.s9.hint: Bring what the knight dropped back to the church.
q19.s10.title: The Depths of Leyndell
q19.s10.recap: You found Hyetta in the depths of Leyndell. She invited you to the Three Fingers.
q19.s10.next: In the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath Leyndell, defeat Mohg, the Omen in the Cathedral of the Forsaken and hit the altar behind the chest to reveal a hidden path. Climb down the platforms to the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace, where Hyetta waits, and speak with her.
q19.s10.hint: Her light leads far beneath the capital.
q19.s11.title: Inheriting the Flame
q19.s11.recap: You were marked by the Three Fingers.
q19.s11.next: Unequip every piece of armour and open the sealed door to receive the Flame of Frenzy from the Three Fingers.
q19.s11.hint: The door below demands a strange kind of surrender.
q19.s11.warn: Taking the Frenzied Flame locks you into the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending and Melina will forsake you - unless you later purge it with Miquella's Needle in Dragonlord Placidusax's arena.
q19.s12.title: Hyetta, Your Maiden
q19.s12.recap: Hyetta accepted you and became your finger maiden.
q19.s12.next: Return to Hyetta at the Frenzied Flame Proscription and speak with her - marked as you now are, she becomes your finger maiden.
q19.s12.hint: Go back to the maiden waiting beyond the door.
q19.s13.title: A Maiden's Rest
q19.s13.recap: Hyetta, content at last, passed on and left you the Frenzied Flame Seal.
q19.s13.next: Exhaust Hyetta's dialogue. Content at last, she passes on, leaving the Frenzied Flame Seal and five Frenzyflame Stones.
q19.s13.hint: Hear out everything she has left to say.
q19.s99.title: Hyetta's Death
q19.s99.warn: Hyetta will never appear if Irina is killed by the player before her scripted death.
q20.name: Alexander's Quest
q20.start: Wedged in a hole in northern Stormhill, past Saintsbridge
q20.s1.title: Alexander in a Hole
q20.s1.recap: You found Alexander stuck in the ground and agreed to help him.
q20.s1.next: Free Iron Fist Alexander, wedged in a hole in northern Stormhill just past the Saintsbridge - strike him with a heavy or charged attack to pop him loose.
q20.s1.hint: A booming voice calls from a hole in the ground, north of the Saintsbridge.
q20.s2.title: Gael Tunnel
q20.s2.recap: You met Alexander inside Gael Tunnel, before a closed door.
q20.s2.next: Speak with Alexander inside Gael Tunnel (by its rear, Caelid-side entrance), where he stands before a closed door.
q20.s2.hint: The warrior jar trains somewhere in a tunnel between Limgrave and Caelid.
q20.s3.title: Radahn Festival
q20.s3.recap: You spoke with Alexander at Redmane Castle before the Radahn Festival.
q20.s3.next: Meet Alexander at Redmane Castle as the Radahn Festival begins.
q20.s3.hint: A festival of war brews at Redmane Castle. An old friend would not miss it.
q20.s3.warn: Talk to him at Redmane Castle BEFORE you defeat Starscourge Radahn.
q20.s4.title: After the Festival
q20.s4.recap: Alexander fought in the Radahn Festival but wasn't happy with his performance.
q20.s4.next: Defeat Starscourge Radahn (Alexander's summon sign joins the battle), then speak with Alexander on the field afterward, south of the Starscourge Radahn grace in the Wailing Dunes.
q20.s4.hint: After the festival, the battlefield is worth checking for a familiar jar.
q20.s4.warn: Exhaust his dialogue here - he needs to be spoken to more than once after the festival before he will move on to his later stops.
q20.s5.title: Stuck Again
q20.s5.recap: You found Alexander stuck in a hole in Liurnia and helped him out.
q20.s5.next: Find Alexander stuck fast in a hole south of the Artist's Shack, close to the Carian Study Hall. Strikes alone won't free him this time: douse him with an Oil Pot, then hit him to pop him out.
q20.s5.hint: That voice from a hole can be heard again in eastern Liurnia.
q20.s5.warn: Missable. If you head straight to Mt. Gelmir you can skip this stuck-in-a-hole encounter entirely.
q20.s6.title: A Lava Bath
q20.s6.recap: You met Alexander soaking in a lava pool. He headed eastward.
q20.s6.next: Meet Alexander soaking in a lava pool near Seethewater Terminus on Mt. Gelmir. Speak with him before he journeys east, hardened.
q20.s6.hint: Where would a warrior jar go to temper himself on a volcano?
q20.s6.warn: You must talk to him at the lava pool. If you skip this stop he will not appear for the final duel at Crumbling Farum Azula.
q20.s7.title: Sparring Match
q20.s7.recap: You met Alexander at Farum Azula. He asked for a duel.
q20.s7.next: From the Dragon Temple Lift grace in Crumbling Farum Azula, head up past the plaza of undead, then cross the archway on the left to reach Alexander on a flat arena beyond the crumbling tower. He asks for a warrior's duel - accept when ready.
q20.s7.hint: The jar's pilgrimage leads into the crumbling storm, beyond the Dragon Temple Lift.
q20.s8.title: Alexander's Sacrifice
q20.s8.recap: You defeated Alexander. He sacrificed himself to give you his contents.
q20.s8.next: Defeat Alexander in the duel. Content with the warrior's ending he has always sought, he gives you the Shard of Alexander and Alexander's Innards.
q20.s8.hint: Alexander waits for the warrior's ending he has always sought.
q20.s8.warn: Winning the duel ends his questline - finish any remaining talks first, and loot him immediately (his body can despawn).
q20.s99.title: Alexander's Death
q21.name: Yura's Quest
q21.start: Under the overpass northeast of the Seaside Ruins grace, Limgrave
q21.s1.title: Yura's Warning
q21.s1.recap: Yura warned you about the dragon at Agheel Lake.
q21.s1.next: Speak with Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at his camp under the overpass northeast of the Seaside Ruins grace. He warns you away from the dragon over Agheel Lake.
q21.s1.hint: A samurai camps under an overpass northeast of the Seaside Ruins.
q21.s1.warn: Yura's whole questline must be finished before you reach the Zamor Ruins in the Mountaintops of the Giants - arriving there ends every earlier stage automatically.
q21.s2.title: Yura's Summon Sign
q21.s2.recap: After you provoked the dragon, Yura offered to fight it at your side.
q21.s2.next: Optional: strike Flying Dragon Agheel at least once, then return to Yura's camp - he leaves his summon sign so he can fight the dragon with you.
q21.s2.hint: Yura has more to say once you have tested the dragon yourself.
q21.s2.warn: Optional. Skipping it costs nothing but Yura's help against the dragon.
q21.s3.title: Flying Dragon Agheel
q21.s3.recap: You slew Flying Dragon Agheel at the lake.
q21.s3.next: Defeat Flying Dragon Agheel in Agheel Lake. Yura's next conversation only opens once the dragon is dead.
q21.s3.hint: The dragon over the lake bars the rest of Yura's tale.
q21.s4.title: The Church on the Coast
q21.s4.recap: With the dragon dead, Yura told you of dragon communion.
q21.s4.next: Speak with Yura again after Agheel falls. He tells of dragon communion and the church on Limgrave's western coast, reached through the Coastal Cave.
q21.s4.hint: With the dragon gone, Yura's trail points west along the coast.
q21.s5.title: The Bloody Finger Nerijus
q21.s5.recap: You and Yura killed the Bloody Finger Nerijus in the Murkwater ravine.
q21.s5.next: Follow the river up to Murkwater Cave - Bloody Finger Nerijus invades. Yura comes to your aid. Defeat Nerijus together.
q21.s5.hint: Something waits for you upriver, past the Murkwater ravine.
q21.s6.title: The Bloody Finger Hunt
q21.s6.recap: Yura told you of his hunt, and warned you of the Bloody Fingers.
q21.s6.next: Find Yura at his new camp a little further upriver and speak with him - he hunts Bloody Fingers, and warns you of them.
q21.s6.hint: Yura has moved on from the ravine. Look further upriver.
q21.s7.title: The Hunt at the Academy Bridge
q21.s7.recap: You answered Yura's summon sign and helped him cut down a Bloody Finger in Liurnia.
q21.s7.next: Yura's hunt has carried him to Liurnia. From the Main Academy Gate grace, follow the bridge north until it breaks - his red summon sign is there. Join his hunt and defeat the Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin (Rune Arc and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy for the win, Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists on your return).
q21.s7.hint: Yura's hunt has carried him north, to a broken bridge near the Academy.
q21.s7.warn: Winning this fight is what moves Yura on. Do this before you reach the Mountaintops of the Giants - once you arrive at the Zamor Ruins his summon sign is gone and the rest of his story is lost.
q21.s8.title: Yura's Thanks
q21.s8.recap: Yura thanked you for the hunt and gave you a Smithing Stone [5].
q21.s8.next: Speak with Yura after the invasion. He thanks you for the hunt and hands you a Smithing Stone [5].
q21.s8.hint: Yura has something to say - and something to give - once the fight is over.
q21.s9.title: Yura's Parting Words
q21.s9.recap: Yura spoke of Eleonora, and said your paths would part for now.
q21.s9.next: Speak with Yura a second time. He tells you of Eleonora, and says the two of you will part ways here - perhaps to meet again. Only this conversation sends him on to the Second Church of Marika.
q21.s9.hint: Do not walk away after the first talk. Yura still has something left to say.
q21.s9.warn: Easy to miss: take the Smithing Stone and leave without talking to Yura again and he stays by the bridge forever - the rest of his questline never opens.
q21.s10.title: The Nagakiba
q21.s10.recap: At the Second Church of Marika, a dying Yura offered you his katana, the Nagakiba.
q21.s10.next: Find Yura at the Second Church of Marika on the Altus Plateau - Eleonora has already struck him down. Speak with him: he offers you his katana, the Nagakiba, and his body can also be searched for a Purifying Crystal Tear.
q21.s10.hint: Yura's hunt ends at a lonely church on the Altus Plateau.
q21.s10.warn: If you never get this far, the Nagakiba is left behind at the last place you spoke with Yura instead.
q21.s11.title: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger
q21.s11.recap: You defeated Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger, at the Second Church.
q21.s11.next: Speaking with Yura brings Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger, down on you at the Second Church of Marika - defeat her. She leaves Eleonora's Poleblade where she fell, along with a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
q21.s11.hint: The one who cut Yura down is not finished with you.
q21.s12.title: Shabriri's Possession
q21.s12.recap: Shabriri, wearing Yura's body, spoke to you of the Frenzied Flame.
q21.s12.next: At the Zamor Ruins in the Mountaintops of the Giants, speak with 'Yura' - the frenzied-flame adept Shabriri now wears his body, and speaks of a great will denied.
q21.s12.hint: A familiar face waits at the Zamor Ruins, changed in unsettling ways.
q21.s99.title: Yura's Death
q22.name: Fia's Quest
q22.s1.title: The Weathered Dagger
q22.s1.recap: Fia asked you to return the Weathered Dagger to its owner.
q22.s1.next: Let Fia hold you at the Roundtable Hold, speak with her in secret, and accept the Weathered Dagger she asks you to return to its owner.
q22.s1.hint: The Deathbed Companion has a favor to ask of those she holds.
q22.s1.warn: Fia's embrace grants the Baldachin's Blessing item but lowers your max HP until you use (or lose) it. She only hands over the dagger after the Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle has begun - embrace her again once it has.
q22.s2.title: Dagger Delivered
q22.s2.recap: You returned Fia's dagger to D.
q22.s2.next: Give the Weathered Dagger to D, Hunter of the Dead, at the Roundtable Hold.
q22.s2.hint: Someone at the Roundtable once carried that dagger.
q22.s2.warn: You must have met D first (he stands watch east of Summonwater Village, or at the Roundtable). Delivering the dagger seals D's fate.
q22.s3.title: Fia's Departure
q22.s3.recap: Fia killed D and left the Roundtable, warning you not to disturb Godwyn's rest.
q22.s3.next: Rest and return: D lies slain and Fia stands over him before departing the Roundtable, warning you not to disturb Godwyn's rest. Loot D's Twinned armor - it serves his brother's tale in Nokron.
q22.s3.hint: After a rest, the Roundtable has changed around the dagger.
q22.s3.warn: Take D's armor from beside his body. It is needed to continue the brothers' story in Nokron.
q22.s5.title: Fia's Champions
q22.s5.recap: You reached Fia in the Deeproot Depths, defeating her loyal champions who barred the way.
q22.s5.next: Reach the Deeproot Depths - after defeating the Valiant Gargoyles in Nokron's Siofra Aqueduct, lie in the stone coffin by the waterfall. Cross the depths toward Fia. A gauntlet of her loyal phantom champions bars the way. Defeat them all.
q22.s5.hint: Fia has gone somewhere deep, where the roots of the great tree reach - and she is not undefended.
q22.s6.title: Fia in Deeproot Depths
q22.s6.recap: You reached Fia at the Prince of Death's throne and let her hold you again.
q22.s6.next: Speak with Fia, seated at the back of the arena. She asks what you intend - answer that you wish to be held and she embraces you. Answering the other way makes her ask you to kill her instead, but you can speak to her again to change your mind.
q22.s6.hint: Fia waits quietly now that her champions have fallen.
q22.s7.title: Another Hallowbrand
q22.s7.recap: Fia told you a second hallowbrand exists and that she must find it.
q22.s7.next: Choose 'Talk in secret' while Fia holds you. She explains that Godwyn's hallowbrand was recovered at the Roundtable Hold, but that another one exists somewhere, and she must find it before their Lord can be received.
q22.s7.hint: Held close, Fia has something she will only say in secret.
q22.s8.title: Fia's Request
q22.s8.recap: Fia asked whether you would still let her hold you once her hands were dirtied again.
q22.s8.next: Choose 'Talk in secret' a second time. Fia says her hands will be dirtied once more by the deed and asks whether you would still let her hold you even then. Once you are carrying the Cursemark of Death, the option to give it to her appears.
q22.s8.hint: There is more she has not said.
q22.s9.title: The Cursemark
q22.s9.recap: You obtained the Cursemark of Death.
q22.s9.next: Obtain the Cursemark of Death, a key item from Ranni's questline. Ranni hands over the Carian Inverted Statue in exchange for the Fingerslayer Blade. Place it on the pedestal at the entrance to the Carian Study Hall to invert the building, then climb through to the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia, where the cursemark lies on Ranni's burnt original body.
q22.s9.hint: A mark of death rests atop a divine tower off Liurnia's eastern shore.
q22.s10.title: Completing the Cursemark
q22.s10.recap: You gave Fia the Cursemark of Death and she granted you a Radiant Baldachin's Blessing.
q22.s10.next: Choose 'Give Cursemark of Death'. Fia recognises it as the other hallowbrand, holds you tighter, and grants a Radiant Baldachin's Blessing.
q22.s10.hint: Fia awaits the mark of death in the depths.
q22.s11.title: Fia's Last Words
q22.s11.recap: You heard Fia out before she lay down with Godwyn.
q22.s11.next: Keep choosing 'Talk in secret' until Fia has nothing new to say. She asks you to brandish her rune, take the throne, and stay the persecution of Those Who Live in Death.
q22.s11.hint: Hear her out fully before you leave her.
q22.s11.warn: Exhaust her dialogue before you reload the area. Once you return she is asleep, and these lines are gone for good.
q22.s12.title: The Death-Prince's Rune
q22.s12.recap: You obtained the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.
q22.s12.next: Rest, then touch the sleeping Fia to enter her dream: defeat Lichdragon Fortissax. On waking, take the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from her - it enables the Age of the Duskborn ending.
q22.s12.hint: Fia's dream has its own guardian.
q22.s12.warn: Burning the Erdtree before Fia leaves the Roundtable can strand her story - see her to the Deeproot Depths first.
q23.name: Varré's Quest
q23.start: The First Step grace, southern Limgrave (the first NPC you meet)
q23.s1.title: The White Mask
q23.s1.recap: You met White Mask Varré at the beginning of your journey.
q23.s1.next: Speak with White Mask Varré at the First Step and exhaust his dialogue. He leaves the First Step once you reach the Roundtable Hold, and can later be found at the Rose Church after you obtain your first Great Rune.
q23.s1.hint: The first soul you met in the Lands Between still lingers at the First Step.
q23.s2.title: Doubting the Two Fingers
q23.s2.recap: You told Varré the Two Fingers 'didn't seem right', and he entrusted you with Festering Bloody Fingers.
q23.s2.next: Find Varré preaching at the Rose Church in the Liurnia lake and answer that the Two Fingers 'didn't seem right'. He gives you five Festering Bloody Fingers. He only appears here after you have obtained a Great Rune and spoken to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
q23.s2.hint: The white mask preaches now at a rose-choked church out in the lake.
q23.s2.warn: Answering that the Two Fingers 'were magnificent' dead-ends the questline.
q23.s3.title: The Lord of Blood's Favor
q23.s3.recap: You proved yourself with three invasions and accepted Varré's anointment, receiving the Lord of Blood's Favor.
q23.s3.next: Invade other worlds three times with the Festering Bloody Fingers (the attempts need not succeed), then return to Varré and choose 'Anoint me' to receive the Lord of Blood's Favor - a white cloth to be soaked in a maiden's blood. Offline players can invade Magnus the Beast Claw instead: his red invasion sign sits in a ruined building at Writheblood Ruins in Mt. Gelmir, guarded by bloodhounds. Since patch 1.06, using that sign three times counts the same as invading real players, and you do not need to defeat him.
q23.s3.hint: Prove yourself in other worlds, then return to the white mask to be anointed.
q23.s4.title: A Maiden's Blood
q23.s4.recap: You soaked the cloth in a maiden's blood, and Varré knighted you into the Lord of Blood's service.
q23.s4.next: Soak the Lord of Blood's Favor in a maiden's blood, then return it to Varré. He knights you into Mohg's service, granting the reusable Bloody Finger, and hands you the Pureblood Knight's Medal when you speak to him once more. The nearest dead maidens rest at the Church of Inhibition in Liurnia's northeastern heights, or at the Chapel of Anticipation reached through the Four Belfries waygate.
q23.s4.hint: The bloodied cloth belongs back at the Rose Church.
q23.s5.title: The Pureblood Knight's Medal
q23.s5.recap: The Pureblood Knight's Medal carried you into Mohgwyn's domain.
q23.s5.next: Use the Pureblood Knight's Medal to be carried to Mohgwyn Palace - a way into Mohg's domain long before the Consecrated Snowfield route opens. It sets you down beside the Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance grace, and it is never used up: you can raise it again any time, even mid-fight.
q23.s5.hint: The medal seems bound to the Lord of Blood's domain.
q23.s6.title: Varré's End
q23.s6.recap: Varré's devotion to the Lord of Blood found its end at Mohgwyn Palace.
q23.s6.next: Find the invasion sign near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint site of grace in Mohgwyn Palace and use it to fight Varré. Defeat him, then return to that corridor - his wounded body lies where the sign was. Exhaust his dialogue to receive 6 Festering Bloody Fingers, a Rune Arc, a Furcalling Finger Remedy and, on his final words, Varré's Bouquet.
q23.s6.hint: Near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint, a sign calls from Varré's path.
q23.s6.warn: Defeating Mohg before invading Varré ends his story off-screen and removes the invasion sign. His body and Varré's Bouquet can still be found where the sign would have been.
q23.s99.title: Varré's Death
q23.s99.warn: Once killed, Varré cannot be revived - not even by absolution at the Church of Vows - and his questline can no longer be completed.
q24.name: Millicent's Quest
q24.start: Church of the Plague, on the heights east of Sellia (Caelid) — Gowry's mended needle in hand
q24.s1.title: Curing Millicent
q24.s1.recap: You stayed Millicent's scarlet rot with the golden needle. She gifted you the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom.
q24.s1.next: Give Millicent the mended Unalloyed Gold Needle at the Church of the Plague, then rest: the rot stayed, she rises - and gifts you the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom talisman.
q24.s1.hint: A rot-stricken warrior clings to life at the Church of the Plague.
q24.s1.warn: You need Gowry's mended needle first - bring him the needle from Commander O'Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia and let him repair it.
q24.s2.title: The Lost Arm
q24.s2.recap: Millicent lamented about her missing arm.
q24.s2.next: Follow Millicent onward: she rests first at Gowry's Shack, then just north of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace on the Altus Plateau, where she laments the sword arm she lost.
q24.s2.hint: Millicent's path runs from Gowry's shack toward a hill with a view of the Erdtree.
q24.s3.title: A Prosthetic Arm
q24.s3.recap: You gave Millicent a prosthetic arm.
q24.s3.next: Retrieve the Valkyrie's Prosthesis from the Shaded Castle in northern Altus and give it to Millicent at the Erdtree-Gazing Hill.
q24.s3.hint: A golden prosthetic arm lies in a castle sunk in poison, in northern Altus.
q24.s4.title: Millicent's Aid
q24.s4.recap: Millicent insisted she can aid you in battle.
q24.s4.next: Defeat the Godskin Apostle atop Dominula, Windmill Village (Millicent's gold summon sign waits near the summoning pool on the way up), then speak with her by the Windmill Heights grace - armed anew, she insists she can fight at your side.
q24.s4.hint: The windmill village hides a false apostle, and Millicent's path passes that way.
q24.s5.title: The Consecrated Snowfield
q24.s5.recap: You met Millicent again in the Consecrated Snowfield.
q24.s5.next: Meet Millicent at the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants. She seeks Castle Sol, and speaks of the left half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion.
q24.s5.hint: Millicent presses on into the snow, searching for a fort of the eclipse.
q24.s5.warn: The Haligtree needs BOTH medallion halves: the right from the Village of the Albinaurics (Liurnia), the left from Castle Sol (defeat Commander Niall). Use them at the Grand Lift of Rold.
q24.s6.title: The Prayer Room
q24.s6.recap: You spoke with Millicent in the Prayer Room of Elphael.
q24.s6.next: Solve Ordina, Liturgical Town's evergaol puzzle in the Consecrated Snowfield to open the portal to Miquella's Haligtree. Descend through its boughs into Elphael and speak with Millicent at the Prayer Room grace.
q24.s6.hint: Beyond Ordina's seal, beneath the boughs of the great tree, Millicent prays.
q24.s7.title: Betraying Millicent
q24.s7.recap: You betrayed Millicent and killed her alongside her sisters.
q24.s7.next: In the scarlet flower field below Elphael (from the Drainage Channel grace), use the RED summon sign to challenge and defeat Millicent - her Prosthesis talisman is your prize, and her story ends by your hand.
q24.s7.hint: Two signs wait by the great scarlet flower field below Elphael.
q24.s7.warn: Branch point: the gold sign fights BESIDE Millicent against her sisters. The red sign betrays her. Choose deliberately.
q24.s8.title: Millicent's Sacrifice
q24.s8.recap: Millicent prevailed against her sisters, drew out the needle, and passed in peace. Her needle serves a greater purpose yet.
q24.s8.next: Use the GOLD summon sign to fight beside Millicent against her sisters (reward: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia). Afterwards speak with her, rest, and take the Unalloyed Gold Needle from where she lies. Once Malenia falls, use that needle on the great flower in her arena to receive Miquella's Needle and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
q24.s8.hint: Two signs wait by the great scarlet flower field below Elphael.
q24.s8.warn: Branch point: the gold sign fights BESIDE Millicent against her sisters. The red sign betrays her. Choose deliberately.
q24.s99.title: Millicent's Death
q25.name: Jar-Bairn's Quest
q25.start: Jarburg, down the gravestone ledges below eastern Liurnia's cliffs (south of the Carian Study Hall)
q25.s1.title: Hello, Coz!
q25.s1.recap: You met Jar-Bairn at Jarburg. He decided your hands were too rough to be Potentate.
q25.s1.next: Descend the gravestone ledges on eastern Liurnia's cliffside, south of the Carian Study Hall, to Jarburg and speak with Jar-Bairn. He asks whether you are the new Potentate, then inspects your hands and decides they are not slick and slidey enough.
q25.s1.hint: A little jar sits on a porch in a village of jars, calling you 'Coz'.
q25.s1.warn: Never break a living jar in Jarburg. It angers Jar-Bairn and puts the whole questline out of reach.
q25.s2.title: The Poacher Problem
q25.s2.recap: Jar-Bairn told you about the poachers who hunt living jars.
q25.s2.next: Keep coming back to Jarburg and talking to Jar-Bairn, resting at the grace between visits, until his dialogue runs out. He offers you the village's flowers, talks about his Uncle Alexander, admits he is a warrior jar himself, and finally warns you about poachers - that last conversation is the one you are after.
q25.s2.hint: Jar-Bairn's story only unfolds across repeated visits to Jarburg.
q25.s2.warn: He will just sleep and mumble about the wide world until you have met Iron Fist Alexander at least once.
q25.s3.title: A New Potentate
q25.s3.recap: Jar-Bairn was excited about Diallos, the new Potentate with the silky hands.
q25.s3.next: Advance Diallos' story at Volcano Manor until he leaves, and he settles in Jarburg. Reload and talk to both of them a few times, until Jar-Bairn admits he is a little disappointed - Diallos' hands are lovely, but he wishes the village had a Potentate as big and strong as you.
q25.s3.hint: Someone else has turned up in Jarburg, and Jar-Bairn is delighted about his hands.
q25.s4.title: After the Poachers
q25.s4.recap: Poachers raided Jarburg. Jar-Bairn resolved to become a warrior who protects everyone.
q25.s4.next: Exhaust Alexander's dialogue in Radahn's arena after Radahn is dead, then return to Jarburg to find jars smashed and Diallos dying in the middle of the village. Jar-Bairn is just south of him, behind his legs - speak to him. He says the tale of House Hoslow is told in blood, and that is the kind of warrior he wants to be.
q25.s4.hint: Jarburg has been attacked, and Jar-Bairn is putting a brave face on it.
q25.s4.warn: If Radahn is dead and you have spoken to Alexander but the raid has not happened, travel to the Starscourge Radahn grace and back, or rest in Jarburg and pass time until nightfall.
q25.s5.title: Diallos' Remains
q25.s5.recap: Jar-Bairn took Diallos' remains into himself, to become a warrior who protects everybody.
q25.s5.next: Reload the area after Diallos dies and speak to Jar-Bairn again. He is kneeling over the body, taking some of Diallos' strength for himself.
q25.s5.hint: Jar-Bairn is keeping vigil over the fallen Potentate.
q25.s6.title: The Path of Champions
q25.s6.recap: Jar-Bairn told you he means to set out as a warrior jar.
q25.s6.next: Reload once more and speak to Jar-Bairn, who is back sitting where you first found him. He tells you it is time he set out on a journey, as a warrior jar upon the path of champions.
q25.s6.hint: Jar-Bairn has been thinking about what comes next for him.
q25.s7.title: Alexander's Legacy
q25.s7.recap: You gave Jar-Bairn Alexander's Innards so he could grow strong enough to travel.
q25.s7.next: Finish Iron Fist Alexander's questline to receive Alexander's Innards, then give them to Jar-Bairn. He is overwhelmed - he needs to be strong, and these are his uncle's.
q25.s7.hint: A great warrior's remains would mean everything to Jar-Bairn.
q25.s8.title: Farewell, Coz
q25.s8.recap: Jar-Bairn said goodbye. Warriors are supposed to work alone.
q25.s8.next: Speak with Jar-Bairn once more. He says he will not see you again once he sets out, because warriors are supposed to work alone, and thanks you for everything.
q25.s8.hint: Jar-Bairn has one last thing to say before he goes.
q25.s9.title: The Companion Jar
q25.s9.recap: Jar-Bairn set out into the world, leaving you the Companion Jar.
q25.s9.next: Reload the area. Jar-Bairn is gone, and the Companion Jar talisman is waiting where he used to sit. Diallos' Mask and Hoslow's Petal Whip are in the middle of town.
q25.s9.hint: Jar-Bairn left something behind on his porch.
q25.s99.title: Jar-Bairn Lost
q25.s99.recap: Jar-Bairn turned on you. His story is over.
q25.s99.next: Quest ended. Jar-Bairn will not speak with you again.
q26.name: Corhyn's Quest
q26.s1.title: Brother Corhyn
q26.s1.recap: You spoke with Brother Corhyn at the Roundtable Hold.
q26.s1.next: Speak with Brother Corhyn at the Roundtable Hold. He teaches the Prayer gesture and sells incantations.
q26.s1.hint: A priest of the Golden Order studies at the Roundtable.
q26.s2.title: The Search for Goldmask
q26.s2.recap: Corhyn decided to leave the Roundtable to find Goldmask.
q26.s2.next: Once you reach the Altus Plateau, Corhyn announces he is leaving the Roundtable to seek the noble Goldmask, and departs.
q26.s2.hint: Corhyn speaks of leaving to seek a noble hero.
q26.s3.title: Corhyn's Search
q26.s3.recap: You met Corhyn on the Altus Plateau. He hasn't found Goldmask.
q26.s3.next: Meet Corhyn just north of the Altus Highway Junction grace, by the map stele. He has not yet found Goldmask, and resumes his trade meanwhile.
q26.s3.hint: The wandering priest has set up by a map stele on the Altus crossroads.
q26.s4.title: Goldmask Found
q26.s4.recap: You found Goldmask frozen in contemplation, pointing at the Erdtree.
q26.s4.next: Find Goldmask on the ruined bridge by the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace - reach it with Torrent's spirit-spring jump, or through the waygate near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge grace.
q26.s4.hint: A golden figure stands frozen on a ruined bridge, pointing at the Erdtree.
q26.s5.title: Informing Corhyn
q26.s5.recap: You told Corhyn where Goldmask is.
q26.s5.next: Return to Corhyn and tell him where Goldmask stands. He thanks you and hurries to join him.
q26.s5.hint: Corhyn would dearly like to know where his hero stands.
q26.s6.title: Reunited
q26.s6.next: Speak with Corhyn at Goldmask's bridge, declaring himself a disciple, he studies the sage's every gesture, and adds Discus of Light to his stock.
q26.s6.hint: Teacher and would-be pupil share a bridge now.
q26.s7.title: The Golden Order Principia
q26.s7.recap: You learned the Golden Order Principia's incantations.
q26.s7.next: Retrieve the Golden Order Principia in Leyndell - from the Erdtree Sanctuary, climb the great branch outside to the upper level. The tome rests on a suspended chair. Hand it to Brother Corhyn, or to Miriel, Pastor of Vows at the Church of Vows - either teacher unlocks its incantations, including the Law of Regression this questline needs.
q26.s7.hint: A fundamental tome rests high in the Erdtree Sanctuary.
q26.s8.title: Radagon is Marika
q26.s8.recap: You revealed to Goldmask that Radagon and Marika are the same person.
q26.s8.next: Learn Law of Regression from Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows (it demands 37 Intelligence) and cast it before the great statue of Radagon in Leyndell, where a message reads 'Regression alone reveals secrets'. Then bring the truth to Goldmask and Corhyn.
q26.s8.hint: A capital statue and a prayer of regression are tied to Goldmask's riddle.
q26.s8.warn: Complete this revelation before Maliketh falls and the capital turns to ash, or Goldmask's enlightenment never comes.
q26.s9.title: Corhyn's Doubt
q26.s9.recap: Corhyn is troubled by Goldmask's revelations.
q26.s9.next: Find Corhyn and Goldmask on the bridge south of Stargazers' Ruins, above the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants. Corhyn's faith wavers under the weight of the truth. (Leyndell's Ashen Capital is where their story concludes, later.)
q26.s9.hint: Faith and doubt sit side by side on a bridge south of Stargazers' Ruins, in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
q26.s10.title: The Perfect Order
q26.s10.recap: You found the Mending Rune of Perfect Order on Goldmask's body.
q26.s10.next: Return to the Ashen Capital once more. Goldmask has passed - find him below the colosseum cliffs, west of the Erdtree Sanctuary grace, and take the Mending Rune of Perfect Order from his body. It enables the Age of Order ending. Reload the area afterwards to loot Goldmask's Set.
q26.s10.hint: Goldmask's contemplation has reached its end in the capital.
q26.s10.warn: Finish the Radagon revelation before burning the Erdtree region into ash, or Goldmask disappears and Corhyn's faith is lost.
q26.s99.title: Corhyn's Death
q27.name: Latenna's Quest
q27.start: Slumbering Wolf's Shack, behind the Lakeside Crystal Cave (south Liurnia) — Albus's medallion half in hand
q27.s1.title: Albus' Medallion
q27.s1.recap: You found Albus and received the right half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion.
q27.s1.next: In the Village of the Albinaurics (Liurnia), strike the lone pot on the ledge to reveal Albus. He entrusts you the RIGHT half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion.
q27.s1.hint: In the ruined village of the silver folk, one pot sits strangely out of place.
q27.s2.title: Latenna's Request
q27.s2.recap: You showed the medallion to Latenna. She asked for your help and joined you as a spirit ash.
q27.s2.next: Pass through the Lakeside Crystal Cave (past its Bloodhound Knight) to the Slumbering Wolf's Shack and show Latenna the medallion half. She asks to be taken to the Haligtree and joins you as a spirit ash.
q27.s2.hint: An archer and her wolf shelter in a shack beyond the crystal cave.
q27.s3.title: The Haligtree Path
q27.s3.recap: As you bore Latenna's ashes through the Mountaintops of the Giants, she spoke of the Haligtree that lies ahead.
q27.s3.next: Carry Latenna's ashes into the Mountaintops of the Giants and press on toward the Haligtree. Take the LEFT half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion from Castle Sol (defeat Commander Niall), then use both halves at the Grand Lift of Rold to open the hidden path to the Consecrated Snowfield. Latenna may speak of the Haligtree as you travel.
q27.s3.hint: The medallion's other half lies with the commander of a fortress of the eclipse, high in the northern Mountaintops.
q27.s3.warn: Take the right medallion half from Albus and receive Latenna's ashes before claiming the left half at Castle Sol. Claiming the left half first causes Latenna to die and the quest to fail. Her remark in the Mountaintops is optional and does not always play.
q27.s4.title: Latenna's Final Rest
q27.s4.recap: Latenna reached her journey's end at the Apostate Derelict, leaving you a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
q27.s4.next: At the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield's far northwest, summon Latenna's ashes before the giant Albinauric woman. Her journey ends, and she leaves you a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
q27.s4.hint: At the snowfield's far northwest, a giant of Latenna's kind waits in a derelict church.
q27.s99.title: Latenna's Death
q28.name: Bernahl's Quest
q28.s1.title: Bernahl's Lessons
q28.s1.recap: You met Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack. He teaches Ashes of War.
q28.s1.next: Meet Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack on Stormhill. He sells Ashes of War.
q28.s1.hint: A war master idles at a shack on Stormhill, selling the arts of battle.
q28.s2.title: Volcano Manor Warning
q28.s2.recap: You met Bernahl at Volcano Manor. He warned you about the nature of the Manor.
q28.s2.next: After joining Volcano Manor, find Bernahl in the drawing room. He speaks plainly about what the Manor is.
q28.s2.hint: The war master has taken up an old cause at Volcano Manor.
q28.s3.title: First Mission Reward
q28.s3.recap: Bernahl started teaching new arts after you completed your first Manor mission.
q28.s3.next: Complete the Manor's first assassination request, then speak with Bernahl. He acknowledges you as a fellow recusant, his wares still on offer.
q28.s3.hint: After the Manor's first contract, Bernahl may have more to say.
q28.s4.title: The Roundtable Hunt
q28.s4.recap: Bernahl gave you the Letter to Bernahl, naming other Tarnished of the Roundtable to hunt.
q28.s4.next: Receive the Letter to Bernahl: two Tarnished of the Roundtable - Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm - are to be hunted.
q28.s4.hint: Bernahl has a letter of his own for you.
q28.s5.title: Hunt Complete
q28.s5.recap: You completed the hunt, slaying Vargram and Wilhelm.
q28.s5.next: Invade via the red summon sign in Leyndell, Royal Capital, and slay Vargram and Wilhelm together.
q28.s5.hint: Your marks were last seen inside the royal capital.
q28.s6.title: Bernahl's Reward
q28.s6.recap: You reported back to Bernahl and received your reward.
q28.s6.next: Report back to Bernahl at Volcano Manor for your reward.
q28.s6.hint: Bernahl will want word of the hunt.
q28.s7.title: Rising Against the Erdtree
q28.s7.recap: After killing Rykard, Bernahl mentioned rising against the Erdtree.
q28.s7.next: After Rykard is slain, speak with Bernahl at the Manor. He takes up his old cause once more - to rise against the Erdtree - and departs.
q28.s7.hint: With the Manor's lord fallen, Bernahl speaks of his own war.
q28.s8.title: The Farum Azula Duel
q28.s8.recap: You defeated Recusant Bernahl in Farum Azula, claiming the Blasphemous Claw and his scepter.
q28.s8.next: From the Beside the Great Bridge grace in Crumbling Farum Azula, take the walkway toward the Old Lord's Talisman treasure chest (through the door and up the stairs, then north toward the dragon temple) - Recusant Bernahl invades there. Defeat him for the Blasphemous Claw (it can parry Maliketh's black blade), and his Devourer's Scepter.
q28.s8.hint: Past the Great Bridge, an apostate knight watches the path toward an old talisman.
q28.s99.title: Bernahl's Death
q29.name: The Purpose of a God
q29.start: Three-Path Cross and Main Gate Cross, Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow)
q29.s1.title: Miquella's Footprints
q29.s1.recap: You met Redmane Freyja, who once fought alongside Radahn and now follows Miquella.
q29.s1.next: Speak with Redmane Freyja at the Three-Path Cross on the Gravesite Plain, north of the Gravesite Plain grace. She once fought alongside General Radahn and now follows Miquella.
q29.s1.hint: A Redmane warrior rests at the Three-Path Cross.
q29.s2.title: In Search of Purpose
q29.s2.recap: You met Sir Ansbach, once Mohg's Pureblood Knight, now investigating Miquella's purpose.
q29.s2.next: Speak with Sir Ansbach at the Main Gate Cross grace outside Belurat, where he camps with Moore. Once Mohg's Pureblood Knight, he now devotes himself to discerning what Miquella truly intends.
q29.s2.hint: An old knight of the Lord of Blood keeps camp on Belurat's approach.
q29.s3.title: A Compass of Scars
q29.s3.recap: You fought alongside Freyja, and she told you how Miquella drew the rot from her wound.
q29.s3.next: Optional: summon Freyja for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion in Belurat Tower Settlement, or for Rugalea the Great Red Bear, then return to her at the Three-Path Cross. She will speak of the Hornsent, and of the wound Miquella healed.
q29.s3.hint: Fight alongside the Redmane, then seek her out again.
q29.s3.warn: This conversation is lost once Miquella's great rune breaks.
q29.s4.title: Six Crosses
q29.s4.recap: You reported Miquella's Crosses to Ansbach, and he pieced together where Miquella was bound.
q29.s4.next: Optional: Ansbach asks you to report the crosses you find. Tell him about the Belurat Tower Settlement Cross, the Scaduview Cross and the Cerulean Coast Cross. Two of them are enough for him to conclude that Miquella is shedding his flesh and making for the tower of shadow.
q29.s4.hint: The old knight wants to hear about every cross you find.
q29.s4.warn: All of this dialogue is lost once Miquella's great rune breaks.
q29.s5.title: The Nature of the Vow
q29.s5.recap: Freed of the charm, Freyja set out to learn the nature of Miquella's vow to Radahn.
q29.s5.next: Approaching the Shadow Keep's front gate, or crossing north past Bonny Village, breaks Miquella's great rune and the charm with it. Return to Freyja at the Three-Path Cross and exhaust her dialogue: she resolves to learn what Miquella's vow to General Radahn really was, and afterwards moves to the Specimen Storehouse.
q29.s5.hint: After the great rune shatters, the Redmane has questions of her own.
q29.s6.title: A Pure Monster
q29.s6.recap: Ansbach confessed that he once challenged Miquella, and called him a monster.
q29.s6.next: Speak with Ansbach again after the great rune breaks. With the fog lifted he admits he once challenged Miquella to free Mohg, and calls him a monster. He then leaves for the Shadow Keep.
q29.s6.hint: The old knight reads the shattered rune differently.
q29.s7.title: Body Snatching
q29.s7.recap: Ansbach told you Mohg's body had been carried into the Realm of Shadow.
q29.s7.next: Both of them relocate once you reach the Specimen Storehouse. Find Ansbach on the Storehouse, First Floor and exhaust his dialogue: Mohg's corpse has been spirited away into this land, and he cannot let it go.
q29.s7.hint: The old knight has taken up residence among the storehouse's books.
q29.s8.title: Is That Even a Word?
q29.s8.recap: You found Freyja on the Storehouse's seventh floor, defeated by a stone slab she cannot read.
q29.s8.next: Find Freyja at the Storehouse, Seventh Floor, crouched over a stone slab she cannot make sense of. Speak with her. She wishes she had asked Ansbach for help.
q29.s8.hint: Somewhere high in the storehouse, the Redmane is losing a fight with some letters.
q29.s8.warn: Speak to Freyja here before you hand Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll, or he leaves and her questline stalls.
q29.s9.title: Hard Road Ahead
q29.s9.recap: You told Ansbach about Freyja, and he saw the hard road she had chosen.
q29.s9.next: Go back down to Ansbach on the Storehouse, First Floor and tell him about Freyja. Exhaust his dialogue afterwards.
q29.s9.hint: Freyja's problem is one the old knight could solve.
q29.s9.warn: Do this before giving him the Secret Rite Scroll.
q29.s10.title: Used and Abused
q29.s10.recap: Ansbach read the Secret Rite Scroll and saw that Mohg's corpse was to be Miquella's consort.
q29.s10.next: The Secret Rite Scroll lies on a table behind tall bookshelves on the Storehouse, Fourth Floor. Give it to Ansbach: he works out that Miquella means to use Mohg's corpse as the vessel for his consort.
q29.s10.hint: The storehouse's fourth floor hides a rite worth showing the old knight.
q29.s10.warn: Handing over the scroll makes Ansbach leave the Storehouse. If you have not yet told him about Freyja, her questline stalls here - the only way back is to side with Leda against him, in which case he drops the letter.
q29.s11.title: Stoking the Flames of War
q29.s11.recap: Ansbach entrusted you with a letter carrying the answers Freyja was looking for.
q29.s11.next: Rest at a grace and speak to Ansbach again. He hands you the Letter for Freyja, holding the answers she has been chasing.
q29.s11.hint: The old knight has something he would rather Freyja read herself.
q29.s12.title: The Great Lion, Reborn
q29.s12.recap: Freyja read Ansbach's letter and learned Miquella means to revive General Radahn.
q29.s12.next: Carry the letter back up to Freyja on the Storehouse, Seventh Floor. Reading it, she learns Miquella intends to revive General Radahn - and decides that endless war suits her lord better than an honourable death.
q29.s12.hint: The letter is meant for the Redmane.
q29.s13.title: Misgivings Cast Off
q29.s13.recap: Freyja thanked you with the Golden Lion Shield and left for the battle ahead.
q29.s13.next: Speak to Freyja once more after she has read the letter. She thanks you with the Golden Lion Shield and asks you to pass her regards on to Ansbach.
q29.s13.hint: The Redmane is not finished thanking you.
q29.s13.warn: If you never deliver the letter, Freyja stays in the Storehouse until the DLC's final boss is dead, and the Golden Lion Shield is simply left on the floor where she stood.
q29.s14.title: The Redmane's Message
q29.s14.recap: You carried Freyja's message back to Ansbach, and it made the old knight laugh.
q29.s14.next: Return to Ansbach on the Storehouse, First Floor and pass on Freyja's message.
q29.s14.hint: Freyja asked you to give her regards to the old knight.
q29.s15.title: A Culling on the Cards
q29.s15.recap: You answered one of the two signs when Leda came for Ansbach.
q29.s15.next: Optional: Leda eventually turns on Ansbach. Two signs appear where he stood on the Storehouse, First Floor - the gold one fights for him and rewards Leda's Rune and Ansbach's Longbow, the red one fights for Leda, kills him, and rewards Ansbach's Set and Ansbach's Longbow. You may also skip the fight entirely and keep him as a summon, forgoing both rewards.
q29.s15.hint: Two summon signs wait where the old knight stood.
q29.s15.warn: Siding with Leda here kills Ansbach and ends his story.
q29.s16.title: To Challenge a God
q29.s16.recap: You stood with Ansbach to the end, and only one foe remained.
q29.s16.next: In Enir-Ilim, Ansbach's gold sign appears for the NPC battle at the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom and again for the final boss. Summon him, then speak with him at the top of the elevator afterwards. Freyja, true to her lord, stands among your enemies in that battle.
q29.s16.hint: The old knight's road ends at the tower's summit.
q29.s16.warn: Ansbach is only summonable for the final boss if you summoned him for the NPC battle first. If you skip that battle he still leaves his gear behind once the final boss falls.
q30.name: Culling the Undeserving
q30.start: Cocoon of the Empyrean, Mohgwyn Palace
q30.s1.title: Touch the Withered Arm
q30.s1.recap: You met Leda beside Miquella's cocoon, and she sent you on to the Realm of Shadow.
q30.s1.next: Defeat Mohg, Lord of Blood to open the Cocoon of the Empyrean grace, then speak with Needle Knight Leda beside Miquella's cocoon and exhaust her dialogue. She invites you to trace Miquella's path and tells you to touch the withered arm.
q30.s1.hint: A white-cloaked knight keeps watch beside Miquella's cocoon.
q30.s2.title: Ah, Finally We Meet
q30.s2.recap: You found Leda again at the Highroad Cross, among Miquella's other followers.
q30.s2.next: Leda moves to the Highroad Cross grace in Scadu Altus once you first enter Scadu Altus. Speak with her there. On the way she leaves two notes about where she is headed: the Tower of Shadow Message in Belurat Tower Settlement, up the lift and the stairs after the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, and the Castle Cross Message beside Miquella's Cross in Castle Ensis. She can also be summoned for Rellana, Twin Moon Knight in Castle Ensis.
q30.s2.hint: The Needle Knight has gone on ahead into Scadu Altus.
q30.s2.warn: Her summon sign for Rellana, Twin Moon Knight is gone once Miquella's charm is broken.
q30.s3.title: Miquella's Congregation
q30.s3.recap: Leda told you about the compatriots gathered around Miquella.
q30.s3.next: Optional: while the charm still holds, ask Leda about the silent monk Dane and about the hornsent. Each topic only appears once you have met the person in question.
q30.s3.hint: Leda will talk about the company she keeps.
q30.s3.warn: Both of these conversations are lost for good once Miquella's great rune breaks.
q30.s4.title: A Charm Undone
q30.s4.recap: With Miquella's charm broken, Leda resolved to cull those unfit to stand beside him.
q30.s4.next: Approaching the Shadow Keep's front gate at Messmer's Army Encampment, or heading north from the Bridge Leading to the Village grace past Bonny Village, breaks Miquella's great rune and the charm with it. Return to Leda at the Highroad Cross and exhaust her dialogue: her own devotion is unchanged, but she decides to take her sword to whoever is unworthy of Miquella.
q30.s4.hint: After the great rune shatters, the Needle Knight has more to say.
q30.s5.title: Who Is Unworthy?
q30.s5.recap: You gave Leda a name to suspect.
q30.s5.next: Optional: Leda asks who she should pursue. You can name Thiollier, name the hornsent, or say nothing - she settles on the hornsent whichever you choose. Thiollier's option only appears if you have met him.
q30.s5.warn: The hornsent can only be named before you first walk into Messmer the Impaler's arena.
q30.s6.title: The Black Keep
q30.s6.recap: Leda resolved to kill the hornsent, and summon signs appeared in the Shadow Keep.
q30.s6.next: Once the hornsent has left for the Shadow Keep, speak with Leda again at the Highroad Cross. She tells you she will follow him to the black keep, and two summon signs appear there.
q30.s6.hint: Leda has chosen her first target.
q30.s7.title: A Question of Sides
q30.s7.recap: You answered one of the two signs when Leda came for the hornsent.
q30.s7.next: Two summon signs wait on the battlements with the burning boats, just before the lift up to the Storehouse, First Floor grace. The red sign fights for Leda and kills the hornsent, rewarding the Falx and the Hornsent Set, with the Lacerating Crossed-Tree from Leda afterwards. The gold sign fights for the hornsent and rewards Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune. You may also ignore both.
q30.s7.hint: Two summon signs wait on the Shadow Keep's battlements.
q30.s7.warn: Both signs vanish the moment you first walk into Messmer the Impaler's boss room from the Dark Chamber Entrance grace - and there is no fog wall there to stop you the first time.
q30.s8.title: The Weight of One's Deeds
q30.s8.recap: Leda closed the book on the hornsent.
q30.s8.next: Return to Leda at the Highroad Cross. If you fought for her she thanks you and hands over the Lacerating Crossed-Tree. If you did not, she tells you once Messmer is dead that the hornsent is no longer a danger. Either way, exhaust her dialogue afterwards - she muses on the weight of what she has done.
q30.s8.hint: Leda has something to say about the hornsent.
q30.s9.title: Sir Ansbach Will Have to Be Next
q30.s9.recap: Leda named Sir Ansbach as the next to be culled.
q30.s9.next: Speak with Leda again at the Highroad Cross. She names Sir Ansbach - once the feared commander of Mohg's Pureblood Knights - as her next target. His summon signs only appear after you have given him the Secret Rite Scroll and finished his business in the Shadow Keep.
q30.s9.hint: Leda's suspicions have found a new target.
q30.s10.title: Two More Signs
q30.s10.recap: You answered one of the two signs when Leda came for Sir Ansbach.
q30.s10.next: Two summon signs appear where Sir Ansbach stands on the Storehouse, First Floor. The red sign fights for Leda and kills him, rewarding Ansbach's Longbow and Ansbach's Set, with the Retaliatory Crossed-Tree from Leda afterwards. The gold sign fights for him and rewards Ansbach's Longbow and Leda's Rune. You may also skip the fight and keep him as a summon for Enir-Ilim.
q30.s10.hint: Two more summon signs wait where the old knight stood.
q30.s10.warn: Siding with Leda here kills Sir Ansbach and ends his story.
q30.s11.title: Retaliatory Crossed-Tree
q30.s11.recap: Leda thanked you for Sir Ansbach's death and gave you the Retaliatory Crossed-Tree.
q30.s11.next: Optional: if you fought for Leda against Sir Ansbach, speak with her once more at the Highroad Cross. She thanks you and hands over the Retaliatory Crossed-Tree.
q30.s11.hint: Leda owes you for the last battle.
q30.s12.title: Farewell, Comrade
q30.s12.recap: Leda took her leave of you and set out for Enir-Ilim.
q30.s12.next: However the two duels went, Leda now leaves for Enir-Ilim. If you fought for her both times, speak with her once more at the Highroad Cross for her farewell and she departs after you rest or leave the area. If you fought for the hornsent or for Sir Ansbach, she goes on her own.
q30.s12.hint: Leda's work at the Highroad Cross is finished.
q30.s13.title: Don't You Dare Approach Miquella
q30.s13.recap: Leda barred your way at the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom.
q30.s13.next: Leda waits just past the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace in Enir-Ilim. Approach and she stops you, then calls in every follower still loyal to Miquella for one last battle.
q30.s13.hint: The Needle Knight is waiting at the top of the tower.
q30.s14.title: The Needle Knight's End
q30.s14.recap: Leda fell, leaving her armour and her sword behind.
q30.s14.next: Defeat Leda and her allies at the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom. Leda's Armor and Leda's Sword can be looted from her corpse.
q30.s14.hint: Only one of you leaves this tower.
q30.s99.title: The Needle Knight Cut Down
q30.s99.recap: Leda died before her hunt could run its course.
q31.name: Revenge
q31.start: Three-Path Cross, Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow)
q31.s1.title: In Pursuit of Revenge
q31.s1.recap: You met the Hornsent, the last of a clan Messmer put to the flame.
q31.s1.next: Speak with the Hornsent at the Three-Path Cross on the Gravesite Plain, where he keeps his distance from Freyja. He follows Miquella's trail but swears vengeance on Marika's kind.
q31.s1.hint: A horned stranger keeps to himself at the Three-Path Cross.
q31.s2.title: Miquella's Footprints
q31.s2.recap: The Hornsent gave you the Cross Map, marking the crosses he has found.
q31.s2.next: Exhaust the Hornsent's dialogue at the Three-Path Cross. He hands you the Cross Map, a diagram of three of Miquella's Crosses.
q31.s2.hint: The horned one has been tracking something across these lands.
q31.s3.title: Fare o' the Tower
q31.s3.recap: You gave the Hornsent a bowl of Scorpion Stew, and he repaid you with Furnace Visages.
q31.s3.next: Optional: after defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, speak to the Hornsent Grandam with the Divine Beast Head equipped to obtain Scorpion Stew, then give it to the Hornsent. He gives you three Furnace Visages. This still works after he moves to Scadu Altus.
q31.s3.hint: The horned one might remember the taste of home.
q31.s3.warn: He accepts only one Scorpion Stew.
q31.s4.title: A New Cross Map
q31.s4.recap: The Hornsent moved to the Highroad Cross and gave you the New Cross Map.
q31.s4.next: The Hornsent moves to the Highroad Cross once you first enter Scadu Altus. Speak with him there and exhaust his dialogue: he gives you the New Cross Map and explains what he believes Miquella means to do.
q31.s4.hint: The horned one has moved on to Scadu Altus.
q31.s5.title: The Spell is Broken
q31.s5.recap: With Miquella's charm broken, the Hornsent told you plainly that Messmer must pay.
q31.s5.next: Once Miquella's great rune shatters, return to the Hornsent at the Highroad Cross. Freed of the charm he declares that Messmer must answer for the flames, and afterwards he sets out for the Shadow Keep.
q31.s5.hint: After the great rune shatters, the horned one has more to say.
q31.s6.title: Not Worthy
q31.s6.recap: You told Leda what you thought of the Hornsent.
q31.s6.next: Speak with Needle Knight Leda after the great rune shatters and raise the subject of the Hornsent. Whatever you say, she reaches her own conclusion about him.
q31.s6.hint: Leda has begun to question her companions.
q31.s7.title: Eliminating Dissent
q31.s7.recap: Leda resolved to kill the Hornsent, and summon signs appeared in the Shadow Keep.
q31.s7.next: Speak with Leda again. She declares she will dispose of the Hornsent before his thirst for revenge undoes them all, and two summon signs appear in the Shadow Keep.
q31.s7.hint: Leda has made up her mind about the horned one.
q31.s8.title: A Question of Sides
q31.s8.recap: You took a side in the duel between Leda and the Hornsent.
q31.s8.next: Two signs wait on the battlements with the burning boats, just before the elevator to the Storehouse First Floor grace. The gold sign fights for the Hornsent and rewards Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune. The red sign fights for Leda, kills the Hornsent, and rewards the Falx, the Hornsent Set and - after speaking to Leda again at the Highroad Cross - the Lacerating Crossed-Tree. You may also ignore both.
q31.s8.hint: Two summon signs wait on the Shadow Keep's battlements.
q31.s8.warn: Both signs vanish the moment you first enter Messmer's boss room from the Dark Chamber grace. Siding with Leda kills the Hornsent and ends his story here. Siding with him keeps his revenge, and his aid against Messmer, alive.
q31.s9.title: Putting Down the Serpent
q31.s9.recap: You summoned the Hornsent to help kill Messmer the Impaler.
q31.s9.next: The Hornsent's summon sign waits inside Messmer the Impaler's arena, by the Dark Chamber grace. Summon him for the fight. He does not have to survive it.
q31.s9.hint: The horned one's vengeance points at the serpent atop the keep.
q31.s9.warn: If you do not summon him he sinks into despair, which closes off his invasion in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh and makes a later fight harder.
q31.s10.title: An Unquenchable Thirst
q31.s10.recap: Messmer's death did not sate the Hornsent - his crusade now takes in all of Marika's kind.
q31.s10.next: Speak with the Hornsent in Messmer's boss room after the fight. If you summoned him he swears his vengeance is only beginning. If you did not, he despairs of ever having it.
q31.s10.hint: The horned one lingers where the serpent fell.
q31.s10.warn: If you did not summon him, rest twice before speaking to him and he leaves for the Highroad Cross without saying his piece.
q31.s11.title: The Reckoning
q31.s11.recap: The Hornsent turned his blade on you at the Church of the Bud, and you cut him down.
q31.s11.next: If you summoned the Hornsent against Messmer and exhausted his dialogue afterwards, he invades you at the top of the staircase near the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Defeat him for the Falx, the Hornsent Set and the Soiled Loincloth.
q31.s11.hint: After the serpent falls, the horned one's trail leads towards the Church of the Bud.
q31.s12.title: In Vengeance for the Flames
q31.s12.next: However his road ends - cut down for Leda, defeated when he invades you at Rauh, or standing among your enemies in the NPC battle in Enir-Ilim - the Hornsent falls with his revenge unfinished, leaving the Falx, the Hornsent Set and the Soiled Loincloth behind.
q31.s99.title: Revenge Denied
q31.s99.recap: The Hornsent died before his vengeance could run its course.
q32.name: Fighting for a Faraway Light
q32.start: A fire knight invades in Belurat Tower Settlement (Realm of Shadow)
q32.s1.title: The Fire Knight's Crusade
q32.s1.recap: You defeated Fire Knight Queelign's phantom in Belurat Tower Settlement.
q32.s1.next: Fire Knight Queelign invades in Belurat Tower Settlement, in the large circular courtyard with the dead tree near the Small Private Altar grace. Defeat him.
q32.s1.hint: A fire knight's phantom hunts the graceless in Belurat Tower Settlement.
q32.s1.warn: Once he has invaded in one location he will not appear in the other until he has been defeated once.
q32.s2.title: The Church of the Crusade
q32.s2.recap: You defeated Fire Knight Queelign's phantom at the Church of the Crusade.
q32.s2.next: Queelign invades a second time at the Church of the Crusade in Scadu Altus. Defeat him there as well. The first of his two defeats drops the Crusade Insignia talisman. The second drops the Prayer Room Key and Ash of War: Flame Skewer, whichever location it happens in.
q32.s2.hint: The fire knight's trail leads on to the Church of the Crusade in Scadu Altus.
q32.s3.title: The Man Behind the Phantom
q32.s3.recap: You found Queelign's living body praying in the Prayer Room of the Shadow Keep's Church District.
q32.s3.next: Use the Prayer Room Key to open the Prayer Room in the Shadow Keep's Church District, and find Queelign himself praying inside. Speak with him.
q32.s3.hint: The key he dropped opens a room in the Shadow Keep's Church District.
q32.s4.title: A Grace Restored
q32.s4.recap: You gave Queelign the Iris of Grace. His prayer answered, he left you his spirit ashes.
q32.s4.next: Give Queelign an Iris of Grace. Believing Marika has answered him at last, he passes on and leaves the Fire Knight Queelign spirit ash. An Iris of Grace can be looted in the Specimen Storehouse, or found at the base of the headless Marika statue reached along the Tree-Worship Passage once the Church District is drained.
q32.s4.hint: The knight begs for a sliver of his god's light.
q32.s4.warn: He accepts only one iris. Giving him the Iris of Grace rules out Queelign's Greatsword, and giving him the Iris of Occultation rules out his spirit ash.
q32.s5.title: Forsaken
q32.s5.recap: You gave Queelign the Iris of Occultation. Denied even his distant light, he died in despair.
q32.s5.next: Alternatively, give Queelign an Iris of Occultation. Robbed of the last of his light, he dies in despair and drops Queelign's Greatsword. An Iris of Occultation drops from the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the drained Church District, or from a Lesser Omenkiller down the well in the main arena of the Fort of Reprimand.
q32.s5.hint: The knight begs for a sliver of his god's light.
q32.s5.warn: He accepts only one iris. Giving him the Iris of Grace rules out Queelign's Greatsword, and giving him the Iris of Occultation rules out his spirit ash.
q32.s6.title: A Faraway Light
q32.s6.next: Either iris ends the fire knight's vigil, and only one of them can ever be given.
q33.name: Star-Crossed
q33.start: Cathedral of Manus Metyr, eastern Scadu Altus (Realm of Shadow)
q33.s1.title: Chance Encounter
q33.s1.recap: You met Count Ymir at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. He gave you the Hole-Laden Necklace and a map to a hallowed ruin.
q33.s1.next: Find Count Ymir behind the closed doors of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, in eastern Scadu Altus beyond Bonny Village. He hands over the Hole-Laden Necklace and the Ruins Map, and sells sorceries. Exhaust his dialogue - he mentions a little boy in the church and asks you to mind your feet.
q33.s1.hint: A high priest keeps a cathedral of the Fingers, east beyond Bonny Village.
q33.s2.title: A Fingery Bell
q33.s2.recap: You sounded the hanging bell in the Finger Ruins of Rhia and were granted the Crimson Seed Talisman +1.
q33.s2.next: Use the Ruins Map to travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia on the Cerulean Coast. Pick your way past the Fingercreepers and the leech-like enemies to the hanging bell and sound it with the Hole-Laden Necklace. Ringing it grants the Crimson Seed Talisman +1.
q33.s2.hint: A great bell waits among finger-shaped ruins on the southern coast.
q33.s3.title: Guiding Stars
q33.s3.recap: Ymir heard the bell and gave you the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust.
q33.s3.next: Return to Count Ymir at the cathedral. The bell's timbre reached him, and he rewards you with the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust. His swordhand Jolán now leans against a pillar in the same room - speak with her, and keep coming back to her as the quest goes on.
q33.s3.hint: The count has more to give a diligent bell-ringer.
q33.s4.title: Second Round
q33.s4.recap: You opened the way to the Hinterlands and sounded the bell in the Finger Ruins of Dheo, earning the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1.
q33.s4.next: From the Shadow Keep, Back Gate grace, face the entrance and go left into the room. Perform the O Mother gesture in front of the altar (the gesture is found north of Bonny Village, before a headless statue) to open a hidden tunnel into the Hinterlands. Cross to the Finger Ruins of Dheo and sound the second bell for the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1.
q33.s4.hint: The second bell lies beyond Shadow Keep's Back Gate, past a hidden tunnel.
q33.s4.warn: Jolán's golden summon signs vanish once Metyr, Mother of Fingers is dead. Call on her against Messmer, against the Tree Sentinels in the Hinterlands, or against the Ghostflame Dragon on the Cerulean Coast before you go down beneath the throne.
q33.s5.title: Joining The Stars
q33.s5.recap: Ymir gave you the Ruins Map (3rd) after both bells had been sounded.
q33.s5.next: Return to Count Ymir once more. With both bells sounded he hands over the Ruins Map (3rd), which he calls his final gift. Speak with Jolán again as well - she has new words now that Ymir is pleased with you.
q33.s5.hint: Ymir's last gift is still at the cathedral.
q33.s6.title: The Nature Of The World
q33.s6.recap: You asked Ymir about the nature of the world, and he spoke of a mother who is damaged and unhinged.
q33.s6.next: With the third map in hand, ask Count Ymir about the nature of the world, then reload the area. His throne will be empty.
q33.s6.hint: There is one more question the count will answer.
q33.s6.warn: If Ymir is still sitting on the throne, exhaust all of his dialogue and rest at the Site of Grace.
q33.s7.title: Mother of Fingers
q33.s7.recap: You descended beneath the throne, took the Claws of Night from Anna, and felled Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
q33.s7.next: Examine the empty throne - it slides back and reveals a rope ladder down to the Finger Ruins of Miyr. Swordhand of Night Anna invades on the way down. Beat her for the Claws of Night, and head back up to tell Jolán about it for more of her dialogue. Then sound the hanging bell at the end of the ruins to be carried to Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
q33.s7.hint: The count's chair hides more than it should.
q33.s8.title: The True Mother
q33.s8.recap: You put down Jolán and then Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, on his own throne.
q33.s8.next: Fast-travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and touch the throne again. Swordhand of Night Jolán bars the way, and beyond her waits Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. Beating him yields the High Priest set, Ymir's Bell Bearing and the Maternal Staff. Cherishing Fingers can then be picked up in the graveyard west of the cathedral.
q33.s8.hint: The empty throne still answers a touch.
q33.s9.title: A Night That Never Was
q33.s9.recap: You gave Jolán the Iris of Grace, and she left you her spirit ashes.
q33.s9.next: Rest, then return to Jolán's pillar - she is slumped on the ground, her sight failing, asking for light. Give her the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan. Afterwards, drop down the cliffs beside the Shaman Village to the side of Rabbath's Rise and examine Anna's puppet there: ushering Anna into the ashes yields Jolán and Anna.
q33.s9.hint: The swordhand of night waits by her pillar, and an iris may answer her.
q33.s9.warn: The two irises are exclusive and both end her story. The Iris of Grace leaves you her spirit ashes and lets Anna be reunited with her. The Iris of Occultation kills her and leaves the Sword of Night instead.
q33.s10.title: Our Night
q33.s10.recap: You gave Jolán the Iris of Occultation, and she found the dark she longed for.
q33.s10.next: Alternatively, give Jolán the Iris of Occultation. It kills her, and leaves you the Sword of Night.
q33.s10.hint: The swordhand of night waits by her pillar, and an iris may answer her.
q33.s10.warn: The two irises are exclusive and both end her story. The Iris of Occultation kills her and leaves the Sword of Night. The Iris of Grace leaves you her spirit ashes instead, and is the only route that lets you reunite her with Anna.
q33.s11.title: One Star Alone
q33.s11.recap: Jolán's night was answered, one way or the other, and her watch is over.
q33.s11.next: Whichever iris you chose, Jolán's watch is over and Count Ymir's cathedral is quiet.
q33.s99.title: Ymir's Death
q33.s99.next: Quest ended. Count Ymir was killed before his story could run its course.
q34.name: The Oldest And Vilest
q34.start: Just past the Pillar Path Waypoint, Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow)
q34.s1.title: Too Angry To Die
q34.s1.recap: You met Igon, broken on the roadside past the Pillar Path Waypoint, screaming curses at Bayle the Dread.
q34.s1.next: Cross the Ellac Greatbridge past the Pillar Path Waypoint and follow the path south. Igon lies on the ground, crying out in pain and cursing Bayle the Dread. Speak to him.
q34.s1.hint: A broken voice curses a dragon's name from the roadside past the waypoint.
q34.s2.title: The Exquisite Pain
q34.s2.recap: You heard Igon out until he had nothing left but the pain.
q34.s2.next: Keep speaking to Igon until his dialogue repeats - 'O-Oh... the pain... The exquisite pain...'. He swears he will yet feast on Bayle's heart.
q34.s2.hint: The broken man on the road has more than one thing to say.
q34.s3.title: Traitor To Dragons
q34.s3.recap: You fought your way to the Foot of the Jagged Peak and put down the two Jagged Peak Drakes.
q34.s3.next: Head south from Igon to the Dragon's Pit, drop from the ritual altar and beat the Ancient Dragon-Man, then take the tunnel out. East lies a lone Jagged Peak Drake, and behind it the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion - exhaust the Dragon Communion Priestess's dialogue there before Igon's story ends, and take the Ancient Dragon's Blessing. Then head north through the pillars to the Foot of the Jagged Peak and beat the pair of Jagged Peak Drakes waiting above it.
q34.s3.hint: Igon's hatred points up the Jagged Peak, and the dragons' own altar lies on the way.
q34.s3.warn: Exhaust the Dragon Communion Priestess's dialogue before you finish Igon's questline - her lore is lost once it is over.
q34.s4.title: A Warrior Until The End
q34.s4.recap: Igon pressed his Furled Finger on you and made you vow to summon him against Bayle.
q34.s4.next: Igon's voice carries from the southeastern corner of the drake arena, where the red smoke is thick. Speak to him there and exhaust his dialogue: he hails you as a fellow drake warrior and gives you Igon's Furled Finger, asking that you summon his soul when you face Bayle.
q34.s4.hint: Igon calls out again once the twin drakes are dead.
q34.s5.title: CURSE YOU, BAYLE!
q34.s5.recap: Bayle the Dread was struck down at the summit of the Jagged Peak.
q34.s5.next: Climb on past Ancient Dragon Senessax to the summit. Bayle the Dread lands as you enter the arena - Igon's summon sign only appears afterwards, just to the left of the entrance. Summon him and bring Bayle down.
q34.s5.hint: The summit of the Jagged Peak is where Igon's curse is aimed.
q34.s5.warn: Igon's sign cannot be found from outside the arena. Look for it inside, to the left, after Bayle has landed.
q34.s6.title: You Shall Haunt Me No Longer
q34.s6.recap: Igon's vengeance was spent, and his effects were left where he last lay.
q34.s6.next: If you summoned him, Igon roars his last over Bayle's corpse. Return to the spot where you fought the twin drakes to collect Igon's Greatbow, Helm, Armor, Gauntlets, Loincloth and his Bell Bearing. Then visit the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion once more - what the Priestess leaves you depends on whether she was ever given Thiollier's Concoction.
q34.s6.hint: Go back to where Igon last called out to you.
q34.s99.title: Igon's Death
q34.s99.next: Quest ended. Igon was killed before Bayle could be brought down.
q35.name: Deep, Cursed Slumber
q35.start: Pillar Path Cross, Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow)
q35.s1.title: Here's To New Beginnings
q35.s1.recap: You met Thiollier beside the Pillar Path Cross, a poisoner who says he is good at nothing else.
q35.s1.next: Find Thiollier next to the Pillar Path Cross grace, southeast of Castle Ensis - the bottom-right cross on the map Hornsent gives you. Speak to him to open his shop. His story cannot move until Miquella's charm is broken.
q35.s1.hint: A soft-spoken poisoner idles by a cross in the southeast of the plain.
q35.s2.title: Express Delivery
q35.s2.recap: You handed Thiollier the Black Syrup that Moore had asked you to deliver.
q35.s2.next: Meeting Thiollier gives Moore something new to say - speak to Moore and he hands over the Black Syrup. Bring it back to Thiollier and choose 'Give black syrup'.
q35.s2.hint: Moore has a gift he has been meaning to pass on.
q35.s3.title: An Elixir For The Weary
q35.s3.recap: Thiollier mixed you Thiollier's Concoction in thanks for the syrup.
q35.s3.next: Talk to Thiollier again and pick 'Ask about black syrup'. He offers to mix something special for anyone weary of the weight of this life - answer 'I am weary of life' and he hands over Thiollier's Concoction.
q35.s3.hint: Thiollier owes you a share of Moore's gift, if you ask for it.
q35.s3.warn: Once Thiollier leaves the Gravesite Plain, Moore will no longer hand over the Black Syrup and Thiollier's Concoction becomes unobtainable - which also locks you out of the alternative rewards at the end of the Dragon Communion Priestess's questline. Finish this before he goes south.
q35.s4.title: A Powerful Charm
q35.s4.recap: Miquella's great rune was broken, and Thiollier found himself haunted by St. Trina.
q35.s4.next: Trigger the message 'Somewhere a great rune has been broken. And so too, a powerful charm' - either by entering the Shadow Keep through the front entrance at Messmer's Army Encampment, or by heading north from the Bridge Leading to the Village grace past Bonny Village. Then speak to Thiollier again: he confesses he cannot stop thinking of St. Trina. Breaking the charm also unseals the Stone Coffin Fissure.
q35.s4.hint: Something has to break before Thiollier will say what is really on his mind.
q35.s5.title: Dreadful Sleep
q35.s5.recap: You found St. Trina asleep among deep-purple flowers at the end of the Stone Coffin Fissure.
q35.s5.next: Descend the hole on the southernmost peninsula of the Cerulean Coast into the Stone Coffin Fissure, drop from the tall cliff and defeat the Putrescent Knight. From the Garden of Deep Purple grace, go straight on until you reach the room of purple flowers, where St. Trina sleeps.
q35.s5.hint: Deep violet lilies are said to bloom past a fissure at the southern coast.
q35.s6.title: Longing For Sleep
q35.s6.recap: You told Thiollier where St. Trina lies, and he set out for the fissure.
q35.s6.next: Go back to Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross and choose 'Tell him St. Trina's whereabouts'. He leaves for the southern coast after you next rest at a grace. He will also set off on his own if you defeat the Golden Hippopotamus, enter the Church District, discover the Fissure Depths grace, or burn the Sealing Tree in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
q35.s6.hint: Thiollier is searching for where St. Trina withers.
q35.s7.title: Sweet Poison
q35.s7.recap: You found Thiollier drowsing beside St. Trina in the Garden of Deep Purple.
q35.s7.next: Return to the Garden of Deep Purple. Thiollier lies on the ground beside St. Trina, drifting in her poison and waiting to hear her voice. Speak to him. If he journeyed south before you beat the Putrescent Knight, his summon sign is available for that fight.
q35.s7.hint: The Garden of Deep Purple is worth revisiting once Thiollier follows the lilies.
q35.s8.title: Poor Thing
q35.s8.recap: You drank St. Trina's nectar until her voice reached you: make Miquella stop.
q35.s8.next: Talk to St. Trina and choose 'Imbibe Nectar'. Each drink kills you outright. Do it four times and her voice reaches you on the death screen - 'Make Miquella stop... Don't turn the poor thing into a god...'
q35.s8.hint: St. Trina's nectar asks for more than one taste.
q35.s8.warn: Every drink is a real death. You need four before she says anything.
q35.s9.title: Kill Miquella
q35.s9.recap: You drank the nectar twice more, and St. Trina asked you to kill Miquella and grant him forgiveness.
q35.s9.next: Keep drinking. A fifth and a sixth death exhaust St. Trina's dialogue - 'Godhood would be Miquella's prison', then 'You must kill Miquella... Grant him forgiveness.' Only then will Thiollier let you speak of her at all.
q35.s9.hint: St. Trina still has more to say than you have heard.
