q35.s9.warn: Thiollier offers no way to pass on St. Trina's words until you have drunk her nectar all six times and heard her out to the end.
q35.s10.title: Don't Lie to Me
q35.s10.recap: You passed on St. Trina's words, and Thiollier called you a liar.
q35.s10.next: Go back to Thiollier and choose 'Pass on St. Trina's words'. He refuses to believe that you heard her voice when he cannot, and warns you not to say it again.
q35.s10.hint: Thiollier should hear what you learned in the garden.
q35.s11.title: Don't Mock Me
q35.s11.recap: You told him again, and Thiollier's patience finally broke.
q35.s11.next: Choose 'Try to pass on St. Trina's words again'. He will stand for it no longer.
q35.s11.hint: Thiollier's doubt may not be settled yet.
q35.s12.title: Mine, And Mine Alone
q35.s12.recap: Thiollier invaded you in his fury, and you put him down. He dropped St. Trina's Smile.
q35.s12.next: Rest at the nearby grace, or drink and die from St. Trina's nectar once again, to bring on Thiollier's invasion. Beat him and he drops St. Trina's Smile. He is then found kneeling in St. Trina's room.
q35.s12.hint: Thiollier's anger will find you before long.
q35.s12.warn: Defeat his invasion BEFORE you fight the NPC allies at Enir-Ilim. Otherwise he vanishes from St. Trina's cave and his story ends early, with none of his rewards.
q35.s13.title: Nightmare
q35.s13.recap: You brought Thiollier St. Trina's words at last, and this time he heard them.
q35.s13.next: Speak to the kneeling Thiollier - he asks what St. Trina told you. Choose 'Pass on St. Trina's words'. He calls you a nightmare come to plague him, and begins to believe.
q35.s13.hint: Thiollier will ask you himself, once he has been humbled.
q35.s14.title: A New Purpose
q35.s14.recap: Thiollier rose to his feet, apologised for doubting you, and took St. Trina's wish as his own.
q35.s14.next: Finish his dialogue in St. Trina's room. Thiollier gets to his feet with a new purpose, and his summon signs become available for the NPC battle and the final boss at Enir-Ilim.
q35.s14.hint: Hear Thiollier out to the end of what he has to say.
q35.s15.title: Her Voice
q35.s15.recap: Thiollier took his place at Enir-Ilim, St. Trina's will his own at last.
q35.s15.next: Summon Thiollier's sign for the NPC battle in the cleansing chamber at Enir-Ilim, and again for the final boss. His full set - Hidden Needle, Mask, Garb, Gloves and Trousers - can be collected near the arena entrance once the final boss is down.
q35.s15.hint: Thiollier's path now leads toward the tower.
q35.s15.warn: If he is not summoned for the NPC battle he cannot be summoned for the final boss, though his equipment still drops.
q35.s99.title: Thiollier's Death
q35.s99.next: Quest ended. Thiollier was killed before St. Trina's words could reach him.
q36.name: Blackguard Big Boggart's Quest
q36.start: Boilprawn Shack, southern Liurnia (just north of the Scenic Isle grace)
q36.s1.title: The Necklace Thief
q36.s1.recap: You met Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack, the thief who stole Rya's necklace, and bought it back from him.
q36.s1.next: Speak with Rya near the Laskyar Ruins first, then find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and buy her stolen necklace back for 1,000 runes. Once he is on good terms with you he can also be summoned for the Magma Wyrm Makar fight at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.
q36.s1.hint: A blackguard camped by a prawn shack in southern Liurnia is holding onto something that isn't his.
q36.s1.warn: Ask Rya about the necklace before you leave for Volcano Manor. If she moves there first, Boggart's questline is closed for the rest of the playthrough and his prawns and crab go with it. Killing him here still gets you the necklace but ends his story on the spot.
q36.s2.title: A Taste for Prawns
q36.s2.recap: You bought Boggart's boiled prawns. Trusting you now, he decided to relocate toward Leyndell.
q36.s2.next: Buy Boiled Prawns from Boggart once the necklace business is settled. He decides you are trustworthy, hands over the Spread Out gesture, and packs up for Leyndell's outer moat.
q36.s2.hint: A rough man may soften if you show an interest in what he has to offer.
q36.s2.warn: Befriending him is what puts him in danger. He only moves to Leyndell, and only dies there, because you bought his prawns.
q36.s3.title: Warnings at the Capital Rampart
q36.s3.recap: Boggart relocated to Leyndell's outer moat, selling Boiled Crab and warning you about the Dung Eater.
q36.s3.next: Find Boggart in Leyndell's outer moat, near the Capital Rampart. He sells Boiled Crab now, and warns you about the Dung Eater he was gaoled with.
q36.s3.hint: Boggart has moved on to the capital's outer walls.
q36.s3.warn: Be careful fighting the giant crab beside him - its Death Blight breath can kill him outright.
q36.s4.title: The Dung Eater Is Near
q36.s4.recap: Boggart told you the Dung Eater was lurking somewhere close by.
q36.s4.next: Once you have freed the Dung Eater's body from the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, go back and exhaust Boggart's dialogue until he says the monster is lurking nearby.
q36.s4.hint: He has more to say about the Dung Eater once that one is loose in the world.
q36.s4.warn: This conversation is the whole questline's bottleneck. It is only offered while the Dung Eater is loose but still undefeated - beat his invasion at the outer moat, or kill him in his cell, before hearing this line and Boggart's story is over. He never becomes wounded, never dies, and the Seedbed Curse on his body is gone for that playthrough, leaving you the other five. Some players skip this line on purpose, because it is what keeps Boggart alive at his crab pot.
q36.s5.title: A Fitting End
q36.s5.recap: You found Boggart mortally wounded by the crab pot. He asked you to let him die rather than be cursed.
q36.s5.next: Reload the area and go back to him. He is dying beside his crab pot - speak with him until he asks you to let him go rather than leave him to be cursed.
q36.s5.hint: Leave the area and return. What he feared has already found him.
q36.s5.warn: Killing him yourself once he is wounded, instead of hearing him out, leaves a body with no Seedbed Curse on it.
q36.s6.title: The Blackguard's Remains
q36.s6.recap: Boggart died as he asked. His body yielded a Seedbed Curse along with his mask, iron ball and bell bearing.
q36.s6.next: Boggart's wish is granted and he passes. Loot his body for a Seedbed Curse, the Blackguard's Iron Mask, his Iron Ball and the Blackguard's Bell Bearing.
q36.s6.hint: Whatever he left behind is still beside the crab pot.
q36.s98.title: Saved from the Dung Eater
q36.s98.recap: Blackguard Big Boggart was saved from the Dung Eater. The monster he feared can never come for him now, so he stays at Leyndell's outer moat for good, cooking his crab. There is no Seedbed Curse to be found on him, and the Dung Eater's other five are enough on their own.
q36.s99.title: Blackguard's End
q36.s99.recap: Blackguard Big Boggart died before his story could run its course. His tale ends here.
q36.s99.next: Boggart is dead - loot his body for the Blackguard's Iron Mask, his Iron Ball and the Blackguard's Bell Bearing.
q36.s99.warn: Killing him in Liurnia still gets you Rya's necklace, but forfeits his prawns and crab, the Magma Wyrm Makar summon, and the Seedbed Curse his own ending would have left.
q37.name: Tanith's Quest
q37.start: Volcano Manor, Mt. Gelmir - reached on foot, or by Rya's invitation
q37.s1.title: Joining the Family
q37.s1.recap: You accepted Tanith's offer and joined the Volcano Manor family, receiving the Drawing-Room Key.
q37.s1.next: Speak with Tanith in Volcano Manor's entrance hall and accept her offer to join the family. She gives you the Drawing-Room Key, which opens the dormitories and the other guests' rooms.
q37.s1.hint: The mistress of Volcano Manor welcomes new arrivals in its entrance hall.
q37.s2.title: First Order: Old Knight Istvan
q37.s2.recap: You accepted the Manor's first assassination request and defeated Old Knight Istvan near Stormhill's Divine Bridge.
q37.s2.next: Take the Letter from Volcano Manor from the table in the room where Rya is located, along with the Recusant Finger beside it, then invade via the red summon sign next to the Divine Bridge on Stormhill (Limgrave) and defeat Old Knight Istvan. Report back to Tanith for the Magma Shot sorcery.
q37.s2.hint: The Manor's first contract points toward a bridge on Stormhill.
q37.s3.title: Second Order: Rileigh the Idle
q37.s3.recap: You accepted the Manor's second assassination request and defeated Rileigh the Idle on the Altus Plateau.
q37.s3.next: Reload the area, then take the second Letter from Volcano Manor from the table. Invade and defeat Rileigh the Idle on the Altus Plateau, then report back to Tanith for the Serpentbone Blade.
q37.s3.hint: The Manor's second contract leads to the Altus Plateau.
q37.s4.title: Third Order: Juno Hoslow
q37.s4.recap: You accepted the Manor's third assassination request and defeated Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood, in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
q37.s4.next: Reload the area again, then take the Red Letter from the table. Invade and defeat Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood, in the Mountaintops of the Giants, then report back to Tanith for the Taker's Cameo talisman.
q37.s4.hint: The Manor's third and final contract lies far to the east, among the giants' mountaintops.
q37.s4.warn: If you kill Rykard before coming back to report, Tanith no longer hands the reward over in person - it is left for you on the same table the letters came from.
q37.s5.title: Defeat Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
q37.s5.recap: You completed all three assassination requests and defeated Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
q37.s5.next: With all three requests complete, accept Tanith's offer to meet the Manor's true lord. She sends you straight to a Site of Grace just outside his chamber. Defeat Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
q37.s5.hint: Completing every contract opens the way to the Manor's hidden master.
q37.s5.warn: Rykard's death empties the Manor - Tanith says she will leave before long, and no further assassination letters appear. Take all three contracts before you face him.
q37.s6.title: The Serpent's Feast
q37.s6.recap: With Rykard slain, Tanith moved to his corpse and revealed her true, serpentine nature, feasting on his remains.
q37.s6.next: Speak to Tanith once more in the Manor, then return to Rykard's boss arena once she has gone. She is feasting on his corpse there, and asks to be left to it. Her tale ends here.
q37.s6.hint: The Manor's hostess may have gone to pay her respects to its fallen lord.
q37.s6.warn: Attacking Tanith summons Tanith's Knight to defend her, and ends her story then and there. You can also hand her the Dancer's Castanets from Patches at this point, though it changes nothing.
q37.s99.title: Tanith Slain
q37.s99.recap: You drew steel on Tanith rather than witness her feast. She vanished and her defender, Tanith's Knight, came for you - he leaves behind the Aspect of the Crucible: Breath and her Consort's Set. Her tale ends here.
q37.s99.next: Tanith's story has ended in blood.
q38.name: Together, We Work
q38.start: Main Gate Cross, Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow)
q38.s1.title: A Merchant Outside Belurat
q38.s1.recap: You met Moore, the gentle giant who provisions Miquella's followers.
q38.s1.next: Speak with Moore at his little camp by the Main Gate Cross grace, outside Belurat Tower Settlement, where he keeps company with Sir Ansbach. Talking to him opens his shop.
q38.s1.hint: A huge, soft-spoken merchant keeps camp on Belurat's approach.
q38.s2.title: Many Things We Have Found
q38.s2.recap: You bought from Moore's stock, and he opened up about the brood he works with.
q38.s2.next: Buy anything from Moore. Once you have, he has more to say - about Leda, about her allies, and about the forager brood who gather for him.
q38.s2.hint: The giant's stock is worth a look, and he warms to a customer.
q38.s3.title: A Gift for Thiollier
q38.s3.recap: Moore gave you the Black Syrup he had found for Thiollier.
q38.s3.next: Optional: meet Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross grace, then come back to Moore. He hands you the Black Syrup that Thiollier asked him to find, for you to carry back.
q38.s3.hint: Moore has been looking for something on someone else's behalf.
q38.s3.warn: He only parts with the Black Syrup while both he and Thiollier are still at their first camps. Once either of them moves on it is gone for this playthrough.
q38.s4.title: The Shivering Forager
q38.s4.recap: You warmed the shivering forager brood back to life.
q38.s4.next: Optional: one of the forager brood, north of the Church of the Crusade in Scadu Altus, is shivering and unresponsive. Use a Warming Stone or a Sunwarmth Stone on it, then quit and reload to collect Forager Brood Cookbook (4).
q38.s4.hint: One of the little foragers is too cold to move.
q38.s5.title: The Brood Give Their Thanks
q38.s5.recap: The forager brood thanked you through Moore with their last cookbook.
q38.s5.next: Return to Moore after warming the shivering forager. The brood thank you through him with Forager Brood Cookbook (7).
q38.s5.hint: The foragers want to thank you, and Moore speaks for them.
q38.s6.title: Kindly Miquella's Light Is Gone
q38.s6.recap: With the charm broken, Moore asked whether his kind must be sad forever.
q38.s6.next: Approaching the Shadow Keep's front gate, or heading north past Bonny Village, breaks Miquella's great rune and the charm with it. Speak with Moore afterwards: he says the light is gone but that he still stands tall, and then asks you whether his brood must be sad forever.
q38.s6.hint: After the great rune shatters, the giant has a question for you.
q38.s7.title: Must We Be Sad Forever?
q38.s7.next: Answer Moore's question. 'Put it behind you' sends him on, and he stands against you among Leda's allies at Enir-Ilim. 'Remain sad forever' sinks him deeper into despair, and he leaves for the Church of the Crusade to fade. 'I don't know' leaves him where he is and lets you answer again later.
q38.s7.hint: Moore is waiting on an answer from you.
q38.s7.warn: Collect every Forager Brood Cookbook and the Black Syrup before you answer anything but 'I don't know'. Sending him on or leaving him to his despair closes off whatever you have not already taken.
q38.s8.title: This Thing, Cannot Be Forgiven
q38.s8.recap: You cut Moore down when he came for you over his slain brood.
q38.s8.next: Optional: kill one of the friendly forager brood and Moore warns you the next time you speak. Kill a second and he invades you where it fell. Beat him and he leaves Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield and the Verdigris Set behind.
q38.s8.hint: Harm the foragers twice and Moore will come for you himself.
q38.s8.warn: Killing Moore in his invasion ends his story on the spot, and takes the Black Syrup and any cookbooks you have not yet collected with it.
q38.s9.title: Sad, Forever?
q38.s9.next: However you answered him, Moore's story closes: cut down when he invades you, felled among Leda's allies at Enir-Ilim, left to fade outside the Church of the Crusade beside the fourth forager, or still at his camp with his brood, the last of Miquella's followers left standing. Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield and the Verdigris Set are left wherever he falls.
q38.s99.title: A Tragedy, This Is
q38.s99.recap: Moore died before his story could run its course.
q39.name: The Sculpted Keeper
q39.start: The locked Storeroom across from the Small Private Altar grace in Belurat
q39.s1.title: The Storeroom Key
q39.s1.recap: You found Hornsent Grandam in the locked Storeroom and heard her condemn you as one of Messmer's followers.
q39.s1.next: Find the Storeroom Key in Belurat, then unlock the Storeroom across from the Small Private Altar grace and speak with Hornsent Grandam.
q39.s1.hint: A locked Storeroom lies across from the Small Private Altar grace.
q39.s1.warn: Speak with her before fighting the Divine Beast Dancing Lion if you want to hear all of her opening dialogue.
q39.s2.title: The Divine Beast Head
q39.s2.recap: Wearing the Divine Beast Head, you convinced Grandam that you were a Sculpted Keeper.
q39.s2.next: Defeat the Divine Beast Dancing Lion. Equip the Divine Beast Head, return to the Storeroom, and speak with Hornsent Grandam.
q39.s2.hint: The sacred beast's head changes whom Grandam believes stands before her.
q39.s2.warn: Do this before defeating Messmer the Impaler. Killing Messmer before Grandam accepts you locks you out of her quest and rewards.
q39.s3.title: Watchful Spirit
q39.s3.recap: Grandam taught you Watchful Spirit and offered you Scorpion Stew as a Sculpted Keeper.
q39.s3.next: Speak with Grandam again and exhaust her dialogue. She asks you to take vengeance on Messmer and grants Watchful Spirit and Scorpion Stew.
q39.s3.hint: The Grandam has a song and a meal for the Sculpted Keeper.
q39.s3.warn: Killing Grandam prevents you from receiving any more Scorpion Stew.
q39.s4.title: Another Scorpion Stew
q39.s4.recap: After returning to the Storeroom, you received another Scorpion Stew from Grandam.
q39.s4.next: Reload Belurat by resting at a Site of Grace, then speak with Grandam again for another Scorpion Stew. She can replace it whenever you no longer have one.
q39.s4.warn: Do this before defeating Messmer if you want the extra serving.
q39.s5.title: Gourmet Scorpion Stew
q39.s5.recap: After Messmer's defeat, Grandam celebrated your vengeance with Gourmet Scorpion Stew.
q39.s5.next: Defeat Messmer the Impaler, then return to Grandam in the Storeroom and speak with her to receive Gourmet Scorpion Stew. Rest and return once more to find her asleep and collect another.
q39.s5.hint: Grandam awaits news of Messmer in the Belurat Storeroom.
q39.s5.warn: This is the only way to receive Gourmet Scorpion Stew.
q39.s99.title: Grandam's Quest Ended
q39.s99.recap: Hornsent Grandam was slain, or Messmer's death left her unable to continue. Her quest and further stews are lost.
q40.name: The Way of the Warrior
q40.start: Moorth Ruins, Scadu Altus (Realm of Shadow)
q40.s1.title: Seek Me to the East
q40.s1.recap: You found the silent monk waiting at the Moorth Ruins.
q40.s1.next: Pick up the Monk's Missive and the May the Best Win gesture at the Highroad Cross grace, then follow the missive east to the Moorth Ruins in Scadu Altus. Dryleaf Dane waits there. He will not speak - Leda can tell you who he is.
q40.s1.hint: A letter at the Highroad Cross points east, to someone who wants a bout rather than a conversation.
q40.s2.title: There Is No Need for Words
q40.s2.recap: You challenged Dane with the May the Best Win gesture.
q40.s2.next: Stand before Dane and perform the May the Best Win gesture. He answers by fighting you, hand to hand.
q40.s2.hint: The missive says you will challenge him. It also says there is no need for words.
q40.s3.title: May the Best Win
q40.s3.recap: You bested Dane in his bout and took the Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat.
q40.s3.next: Win the bout. Dane leaves the Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat where he stood. The rest of his outfit - the Dryleaf Robe, Arm Wraps and Cuissardes - lies under a waterfall in the Ruins of Unte, reached by the coffin below Shadow Keep. He can also be summoned against Romina, Saint of the Bud.
q40.s3.hint: Beat him at his own game and he leaves something behind.
q40.s4.title: Grow Not Complacent
q40.s4.recap: You read the message Dane left where you fought him.
q40.s4.next: Optional: after the bout, a message is left where Dane stood. Read it - it is as close as he comes to speaking to you.
q40.s4.hint: He left something to read where the bout was fought.
q40.s5.title: Among Miquella's Own
q40.s5.recap: Dane left the Moorth Ruins to stand with Leda at the tower's summit.
q40.s5.next: Whatever passed between you at the Moorth Ruins, Dane joins Leda and the rest of Miquella's followers at the top of Enir-Ilim. Approach Leda past the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace and she calls them all in - Dane among them, and always against you.
q40.s5.hint: The silent monk has gone on to the tower.
q40.s6.title: Dane's Footwork
q40.s6.recap: Dane fell in the battle at the Cleansing Chamber, leaving his art behind.
q40.s6.next: Defeat Dane along with Leda and the rest of her allies at the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom. Dane's Footwork can be looted from his corpse in the same room.
q40.s6.hint: The last bout is fought at the top of the tower, and not one-on-one.
q40.s99.title: The Bout Cut Short
q40.s99.recap: Dane died before his road reached the tower.
q41.name: A Dragon Whole
q41.start: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion, Jagged Peak (Realm of Shadow)
q41.s1.title: Feasting Upon a Dragon's Essence
q41.s1.recap: You met the Dragon Communion Priestess, and she offered you a dragon's essence.
q41.s1.next: Head south from the lake near the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace to reach the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. The priestess standing beside it invites you to picture yourself feasting upon a dragon's essence, and offers you a choice.
q41.s1.hint: Someone keeps the altar deep in the Dragon's Pit.
q41.s2.title: The Ancient Dragon's Blessing
q41.s2.recap: You devoured the draconic essence and received the Ancient Dragon's Blessing.
q41.s2.next: Choose to devour the draconic essence. She sends you to the jagged peak to slay Bayle, and grants you the Ancient Dragon's Blessing in the name of her lord, Placidusax.
q41.s2.hint: She is offering you something. You may refuse, and change your mind later.
q41.s3.title: Of Bayle and of Igon
q41.s3.recap: You asked the priestess about Bayle's treachery and about Igon.
q41.s3.next: Optional: ask the priestess about Bayle, who turned on the Dragonlord and wounded him, and about Igon, the broken drake warrior who reminds her of Bayle himself.
q41.s3.hint: She has been here a very long time, and remembers.
q41.s3.warn: All of her dialogue is lost once Igon's story ends.
q41.s4.title: A Solace Meant for Her Lord
q41.s4.recap: You gave the priestess Thiollier's Concoction, and she fell into the deep slumber.
q41.s4.next: Optional: bring Thiollier's Concoction to the altar at night, while she is speaking with Placidusax. Give it to her and she drinks it, and falls asleep.
q41.s4.hint: She only keeps her nightly vigil after dark, and there is something that could ease it.
q41.s4.warn: Thiollier's Concoction comes from the Black Syrup, which Moore only gives out while he and Thiollier are both still on the Gravesite Plain. She will not take it once Bayle is dead.
q41.s5.title: Fallen From Grace
q41.s5.recap: The priestess woke a day later, ashamed of having taken the sleep meant for her lord.
q41.s5.next: Wait one full day and return. She wakes and calls it a craven act - the slumber she took was meant for her lord, and she believes he will no longer look upon her.
q41.s5.hint: Let a day pass before you come back to her.
q41.s6.title: The Oldest, and Vilest
q41.s6.recap: You climbed the Jagged Peak and killed Bayle the Dread.
q41.s6.next: Climb to the top of the Jagged Peak and defeat Bayle the Dread, the traitor who once wounded Placidusax.
q41.s6.hint: The peak's summit holds the dragon she wants dead.
q41.s7.title: Return to the Grand Altar
q41.s7.recap: You returned to the altar and collected what the priestess left you.
q41.s7.next: Go back to the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. If she never drank Thiollier's Concoction she is gone, leaving the Priestess Heart and the Flowerstone Gavel where she stood. If she did drink it, she is still there, and hands you the Dragonbolt of Florissax.
q41.s7.hint: Whatever became of her, the altar is worth one more visit.
q41.s8.title: A Craven Act, Confessed
q41.s8.recap: You admitted it was your hand that put the priestess to sleep.
q41.s8.next: Optional: speak with her again and confess that it was you who put her to sleep. She refuses to lay the blame on you, but decides you owe her something for it.
q41.s8.hint: She still does not know why she slept.
q41.s9.title: Lead Me, and I Will Follow
q41.s9.recap: The priestess's story reached its end at the altar she kept.
q41.s9.next: However it ended, the priestess is finished with the Grand Altar. If you confessed, speak to her once more and take her with you - she pledges herself to you as her new lord and leaves you the Ancient Dragon Florissax spirit ashes.
q41.s9.warn: Her two endings are exclusive. Giving her the Concoction trades the Priestess Heart and the Flowerstone Gavel for the Dragonbolt of Florissax and her spirit ashes.
q41.s99.title: The Last of Her Kind
q41.s99.recap: The priestess was slain at the altar she kept.
